articles.descEn: The invisible SynthID will remain.
articles.titleEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from AI content - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Visible watermarks are a great tool to help regular people quickly identify deepfakes, which in turn can help us live in a shared reality.
Google VP Josh Woodward just announced that users will be able to remove visible watermarks from AI-generated images and videos.
This includes the EU, which recently announced new rules on AI transparency that mandate visible watermarks on any "authentic-looking" deepfake content.

articles.title: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
articles.descEn: The rare US-China partnership comes as Apple prepares to roll out its on-device generative AI service in China.
articles.titleEn: Apple trained its own AI model for China with help from Alibaba
summaryLinesEn: The China-focused model gives Apple a leg up as a US company navigating Beijing’s difficult regulatory landscape, particularly given escalating tensions surrounding AI development in recent months.
The China-focused large language model was developed in partnership with Alibaba and trained with the company’s support, Reuters reports , citing three unnamed people familiar with the matter.
The report comes as Apple gears up to release Apple Intelligence in China.

articles.title: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is 'for everyone'?
articles.descEn: Watch as Equity unpacks Meta’s Glimmer release and “AI for everyone” vision, the rising costs of AI data centers, Joby’s defense push, and a $250M acquisition that collapsed into allegations of fraud.
articles.titleEn: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is 'for everyone'?
summaryLinesEn: Apps Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store Sarah Perez AI Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs Anna Heim Climate Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct Tim De Chant

On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Kirsten Korosec, Anthony Ha, and Rebecca Bellan take a look at Glimmer, Zuckerberg’s 6,500-word manifesto, and more of the week’s headlines, from the true cost of the AI industry’s energy needs to a $250M acquisition gone very wrong.

The release landed alongside a letter from Mark Zuckerberg arguing AI should be “for everyone” rather than controlled by a handful of labs, but as Equity’s hosts point out, the vision comes with some asterisks .

articles.title: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
articles.descEn: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermarks from images, videos, and music generated with Gemini and its other AI tools.
articles.titleEn: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks
summaryLinesEn: Instead, OpenAI relies on SynthID and C2PA to signal whether something is AI-generated, while Meta launched its own Content Seal standard .
Google plans on rolling out its new watermark setting to Search as well, but the toggle won’t launch in countries that require visible watermarks.

Though visible watermarks are now optional, AI-generated content will have invisible SynthID watermarks and C2PA metadata embedded in the background, according to Josh Woodward , the vice president of Google Labs, Gemini, and AI Studio.

articles.title: Lower Intro Price for Gemini 3.7 Flash to Attract Developers
articles.descEn: Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash with an introductory pricing strategy aimed at attracting enterprise developers.
articles.titleEn: Lower Intro Price for Gemini 3.7 Flash to Attract Developers
summaryLinesEn: Google is offering the model at an introductory price of $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, lower than the prices for models released by Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceXAI in recent weeks.

Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash, just three weeks after releasing Gemini 3.6 Flash, a testament to how fast the AI race is moving and to the application that vendors see as most compelling to enterprises.
The pricing battle stems from enterprises' concerns about the high cost of using AI tokens and models for their AI goals and workflows .

articles.descEn: US groups release cheaper models after new challenges to their trillion-dollar ambitions.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI recently said that it was slashing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna, its “fastest and most affordable model”, by 80 percent.
Anthropic launched Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens—half the price of its Fable 5 model.

Corporate AI users face cost pressures as Anthropic and OpenAI shift some enterprise customers away from flat subscriptions and toward usage-based billing, under which companies pay according to the computational resources they consume.

articles.descEn: NRIでは、独自の調査に基づき、運用方針や運用実態に沿って投資信託の分類 （Fundmark分類：約300分類）を行っています。
articles.titleEn: Fundmark Report 最新号（2026年8月号）
summaryLinesEn: 「Fundmark」は、国内で販売されている追加型投資信託の運用実績を用いて、各商品ごとにパフォーマンスの比較・評価を行っています。
そこで、NRIでは、独自の調査に基づき、運用方針や運用実態に沿って投資信託の分類 （Fundmark分類：約300分類）を行っています。
同一分類内において、投資信託のパフォーマンスを相対的に評価し、順位（ランキング）や☆印による5段階の評価（レーティング）を発表しています。

articles.title: State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: State of Open Models: Summer 2026 Observations
summaryLinesEn: Not one model published in 2026 reaches the download top 25, while thirteen of the twenty-five date from 2022. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 was pulled 1.55 billion times in seven months against 5,156 likes; Kimi-K3 was pulled about 60 times per like it received.
Going forward, however, the industry is likely to shift toward clearer monetization paths from open-source adoption.
Meanwhile, Chinese open models are increasingly optimized for domestic chips, the same competition in reverse, where models are designed around specific hardware ecosystems.

articles.title: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
articles.descEn: Komdigi, Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA launch the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center, bringing world-class AI infrastructure to Indonesia’s researchers and students and developers.
articles.titleEn: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
summaryLinesEn: “Through initiatives like this, we are laying the foundations of Indonesia’s AI sovereignty and ensuring AI becomes a driver of economic growth, national competitiveness and solutions to Indonesia’s most pressing challenges.”

This week, the Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs (Komdigi), Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Indosat or IOH), NVIDIA and Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) launched the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center (NVAITC) in Yogyakarta — the country’s first university-based AI technology center.
“This initiative supports national priorities in higher education, research downstreaming and talent development by accelerating the adoption of AI and preparing future-ready Indonesian talent.”

summaryLines: "이러한 이니셔티브를 통해 우리는 인도네시아의 AI 주권의 기반을 마련하고 AI가 경제 성장, 국가 경쟁력 및 인도네시아의 가장 시급한 과제에 대한 해결책의 원동력이 되도록 보장하고 있음"

"이 이니셔티브는 AI 채택을 가속화하고 미래에 대비한 인도네시아 인재를 준비함으로써 고등 교육, 연구 다운스트림 및 인재 개발에 대한 국가 우선순위를 지원함"

articles.title: How well do job retraining programs work?
articles.descEn: An evidence review from Anthropic's Economic Research team
articles.titleEn: How well do job retraining programs work?
summaryLinesEn: A small set of “sector programs”—programs that partner with employers in a high-demand industry and place people directly into jobs in that field—produce gains several times larger.
The authors conclude that if AI displaces workers at scale, existing retraining programs would likely fall short.

On average, job training programs produce positive but modest effects: for each person offered a training slot, employment rises by two to three percentage points and earnings by roughly $1,000 a year, against a cost of about $13,000.

articles.title: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
articles.descEn: New releases bring powerful agents to marketing and revenue workflows, with the cost-efficiency, reliability, and control enterprises need as adoption grows.
articles.titleEn: WRITER Makes Agentic AI Economically Sustainable at Enterprise Scale With Palmyra X6 Release and Major Harness Upgrades
summaryLinesEn: Together, the upgrades allow marketing and revenue teams to confidently scale their most ambitious agentic workflows in production without token costs holding them back.

New governance tools to control spend and scale what works WRITER also launched a major upgrade to reporting and governance controls that gives leaders a clear view into the agentic workflows being used across their teams.

X6 delivered the best combination of capability and cost among the models WRITER tested, scoring an average of 0.87 (out of 1.00) across all nine evaluations at $2 per million input tokens and $8 per million output tokens, ahead of Claude Opus 4.8 (0.86 at $15/$75 per million), Claude Sonnet 4.6 (0.85 at $3/$15), GPT-5.5 (0.80 at $5/$15) and Gemini 3.1 (0.77 at $2.50/$10).

지출을 제어하고 효과를 확장하는 새로운 거버넌스 도구 WRITER는 또한 리더들이 팀 전체에서 사용되는 에이전트 워크플로에 대한 명확한 보기를 제공하는 보고 및 거버넌스 제어에 대한 주요 업그레이드를 출시함

articles.title: How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops
articles.descEn: See how RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate AI product development and centralize operational intelligence across engineering and operations.
articles.titleEn: How RingCentral builds AI-native work from engineering to ops
summaryLinesEn: With nearly three decades of innovation in business communications, RingCentral has grown into a global company generating more than $2.6 billion in annual revenue, with thousands of employees worldwide.
By reducing manual coordination, ChatGPT Work enables RingCentral’s PMO to handle more projects with greater accuracy.

AI accelerates the entire development cycle, while humans remain in the loop, guiding product requirements, providing business context, making architectural decisions, and ensuring every outcome is tested and verified.” —Engineering leader at RingCentral who spearheaded the project Encouraged by initiatives like the AI-Native Challenge, non-engineering departments at RingCentral have adopted AI-native ways of working.

summaryLines: 약 30년 동안 비즈니스 커뮤니케이션 분야에서 혁신을 거듭한 RingCentral은 전 세계에 수천 명의 직원을 두고 연간 26억 달러 이상의 수익을 창출하는 글로벌 기업으로 성장함
수동 조정을 줄임으로써 ChatGPT 작업을 통해 RingCentral의 PMO는 더 많은 프로젝트를 더 정확하게 처리할 수 있음
AI는 전체 개발 주기를 가속화하는 반면 인간은 계속해서 제품 요구 사항을 안내하고 비즈니스 컨텍스트를 제공하고 아키텍처 결정을 내리고 모든 결과를 테스트하고 검증함” · — 프로젝트를 주도한 RingCentral의 엔지니어링 리더 AI 네이티브 챌린지와 같은 이니셔티브에 힘입어 RingCentral의 비엔지니어링 부서는 AI 네이티브 작업 방식을 채택함

articles.title: Pixel phones could soon monitor outgoing calls for scams, too
articles.descEn: Android Authority has seen evidence that Pixel phones' Scam Detection feature will soon be able to monitor outgoing calls, too.
articles.titleEn: Pixel phones could soon monitor outgoing calls for scams, too
summaryLinesEn: We’ll be keeping an eye out for when Scam Detection for outgoing calls shows up in the wild.

A flag in the beta version of Google’s Phone app makes it clear Google is working to expand the feature’s availability: It makes sense Google would want to enable Scam Detection for outgoing calls, too — today, a scammer could hypothetically avoid being flagged by Scam Detection by having you initiate the call, rather than calling you directly.
Pixel phones offer a feature that monitors incoming calls for scams.

articles.titleEn: Smart glasses controversy sidelines the benefits for disabled people | Letter
summaryLinesEn: There have been cases of people using smartphones for illicit purposes, for example surreptitiously filming up women’s skirts.

articles.titleEn: Workhorse Group Inc. Q2 2026 Earnings Call Summary
summaryLinesEn: The company amended its cash flow credit agreement in August 2026 to borrow an additional $10 million, leaving $1.7 million in remaining availability to fund operations.

Workhorse is transitioning from a pure-play electric vehicle manufacturer to an industrial technology company, leveraging core engineering expertise for broader applications like mobile infrastructure.
Operational integration following the Motiv merger is on track to achieve a $20 million annualized cost synergy run rate by the end of 2026 through facility consolidation and headcount reduction.

articles.descEn: The company will pay some iPhone owners to settle a lawsuit, and with a new court order, that will now happen months earlier than expected.
articles.titleEn: Apple's $250 Million AI iPhone Settlement Is Coming Sooner Than Expected. Learn Who's Eligible for a Payout - CNET
summaryLinesEn: The legal machinery for class-action settlements grinds slowly, but a court order today in Apple’s $250 million case over its iPhone AI features potentially speeds things up by seven months.

People who bought one of the following devices between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025, are eligible to receive a settlement payment: The iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max are included because they had the processor and memory to run Apple Intelligence features.
In an earlier statement to CNET Managing Editor David Lumb, an Apple spokesperson said, “Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features.

articles.descEn: DeepSeek has announced price hikes for its V4 models.
articles.titleEn: DeepSeek's AI models are about to cost four times more - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Meanwhile, the DeepSeek V4 Flash model will set you back $1.32 for 1 million output tokens (from $0.28) during peak hours and $0.66 during off-peak.

However, its low cost offering, GPT-5.6 Luna, costs $1.20, less than the DeepSeek V4 Flash at peak hours.

articles.title: How Claude's text watermarking works
articles.descEn: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act. In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.
articles.titleEn: How Claude's text watermarking works
summaryLinesEn: In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.

In the SynthID-Text paper , which introduced the technique we use, Google DeepMind tested this impact by serving a model that used watermarking to a portion of their Gemini traffic and comparing thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings.
In internal testing, we’ve seen no impact of watermarking on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude’s text.

articles.title: How kids feel about AI, in their own words
articles.descEn: Does an AI-filled future seem like promise or peril to today’s teens and tweens? We went right to the source.
articles.titleEn: How kids feel about AI, in their own words
summaryLinesEn: We expected some to tell us they were using it to cheat a little, the way Millennials and Gen Xers opened up CliffsNotes or programmed formulas into their TI-82s, and others to share inspiring ways they were using it.

In a survey published in February 2026 , the Pew Research Center found that 57% of teens in the US had used chatbots to search for information, 54% tapped them to help with schoolwork, and 47% had used them for fun or entertainment.

The project’s goal is to reduce the barriers to democratic participation — to make sure anyone, regardless of race, gender, income, or education level, has an easy way to get the information they need and then think critically about how they want to use it.

localization.title: 아이들이 AI에 대해 어떻게 생각하는지 직접 표현해 보세요
summaryLines: 우리는 밀레니얼 세대와 X세대가 CliffsNotes를 열거나 TI-82에 공식을 프로그래밍한 방식처럼 약간의 속임수를 쓰기 위해 그것을 사용하고 있다고 말하는 사람도 있고, 이를 사용하는 영감을 주는 방법을 공유하는 사람도 있을 것으로 예상함
2026년 2월에 발표된 설문조사에서 Pew Research Center는 미국 청소년의 57%가 정보 검색을 위해 챗봇을 사용했고, 54%는 학업을 돕기 위해 챗봇을 사용했으며, 47%는 재미나 오락을 위해 챗봇을 사용한 것으로 나타남
이 프로젝트의 목표는 민주적 참여에 대한 장벽을 줄이는 것임 · 즉, 인종, 성별, 소득 또는 교육 수준에 관계없이 누구나 필요한 정보를 쉽게 얻을 수 있는 방법을 제공하고 이를 사용하는 방법에 대해 비판적으로 생각하도록 하는 것임

articles.title: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
articles.descEn: The prompts used to create Cully Hill Boys reveals a lot about how much human input generative models need to work.
articles.titleEn: I looked inside an AI generated movie, and the best parts were all human
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic’s Claude was used to come up with prompts, which were sent to Seedance 2.5 to create video and speech, while ByteDance’s Seedream and Google’s Nano Banana were used for image and video editing.
We’re introduced to Cal (Kiatipis), Horace (Rafiq), and Oli (Adesanya) as a trio of longtime friends who just can’t figure out how to realize their dreams of becoming well-known musicians.

Planagan has said that he doesn’t use AI tools in his writing process, and it definitely feels like Cully Hill Boys is a stronger film than Hell Grind because its core narrative was crafted by an experienced, human storyteller with an understanding of proper pacing.

articles.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
articles.descEn: Built as a post-training variation on Z.ai's open source model GLM-5.2, Writer says the new system should provide deployment-ready capabilities at a much lower price.
articles.titleEn: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
summaryLinesEn: The company estimates the new model, combined with changes to the companies harness infrastructure, will cut costs for its customers by as much as 50% for basic tasks.
On Thursday, Writer , which offers AI tools and agents for marketers, launched a new flagship model called Palmyra X6, aimed at solving that problem for its users.

“The cost explosion here is just unprecedented for customers, and so is the degree to which CIOs are giving up on the labs,” Habib told TechCrunch, adding that the AI labs “don’t deeply understand right how to help an enterprise get benefit from AI.”

summaryLines: 회사는 회사 하니스 인프라의 변경과 결합된 새로운 모델이 기본 작업에 대한 고객의 비용을 최대 50% 절감할 것으로 추정함

articles.titleEn: Meta is giving away 15,000 AI glasses to blind and visually impaired people in Ireland - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Meta also teamed up with the Be My Eyes network, so that users can call volunteers through their glasses.
Meta says those 15,000 pairs are enough for every blind and visually impaired adult the charity supports.
Those interested in getting free Ray-Ban Meta glasses from Vision Ireland can register their interest through the charity's website or calling its dedicated phone number: +353 1 882 1910.

articles.title: Apple is reportedly turning to publishers for help with Siri AI - Engadget
articles.descEn: Apple appears to be trying to secure access to new content and other information for Siri AI.
articles.titleEn: Apple is reportedly turning to publishers for help with Siri AI - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: In Engadget's early testing of Siri AI , the digital assistant was a major improvement over the version most consumers have access to right now, but it was hard not to feel like Apple still has a lot of catching up to do.

The Journal did not reveal the specific publishers Apple reached out to, but did note the company has proposed structuring payments around a variable compensation plan, which would see it pay those organizations when their content is used.
Siri AI is expected to be released with iOS 27 when it becomes available to the public sometime later this year.

articles.title: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
articles.descEn: Over a billion people worldwide have livers with excess fat, which can lead to a host of medical problems. Researchers think AI tools can spot the condition—and help stop it—early enough to save lives.
articles.titleEn: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
summaryLinesEn: Its unnatural presence causes inflammation, cell damage, and the formation of scar tissue known as fibrosis, all hallmarks of fatty liver disease, a condition that now impacts approximately 30 percent of adults worldwide .

“The AI could pick up cases of excess liver fat, check for other risk factors such as if the person is overweight, has high cholesterol or type 2 diabetes, and then make a recommendation to the doctor,” says Lazarus.
While the presence of fat in a normal, healthy liver is negligible, many adults and even children have livers where fat exceeds 5 percent or even 10 percent of the organ’s total weight.

localization.title: 지방간 전염병이 있음 · AI는 앞서가는 데 도움이 될 수 있음
summaryLines: 부자연스러운 존재는 지방간 질환의 특징인 염증, 세포 손상 및 섬유증으로 알려진 흉터 조직의 형성을 유발함 · 이 질환은 현재 전 세계 성인의 약 30%에게 영향을 미치고 있음
Lazarus는 "AI는 과도한 간 지방 사례를 포착하고, 과체중인지, 콜레스테롤 수치가 높거나 제2형 당뇨병이 있는지와 같은 다른 위험 요소를 확인한 다음 의사에게 권고할 수 있음" · 라고 Lazarus는 말함
정상적이고 건강한 간에서 지방의 존재는 미미하지만, 많은 성인과 어린이조차도 지방이 장기 총 중량의 5% 또는 심지어 10%를 초과하는 간을 가지고 있음

articles.title: Fable 5's slow adoption suggests corporate willingness to pay for frontier AI has hit a ceiling
articles.descEn: Anthropic's Fable 5 is considered the most powerful AI model on the market, but U.S. companies are barely buying it. According to Ramp data, Fable 5 accounts for only six percent of Anthropic tokens sold. The model's steep price tag suggests corporate AI spending may have hit a ceiling, at least as long as performance gains don't translate into measurable everyday value.

articles.title: 'Specialists aren't required' anymore: How to stay valuable in an AI agent workplace today
articles.descEn: Versatility is in, with people expected to work across the tech stack.
articles.titleEn: 'Specialists aren't required' anymore: How to stay valuable in an AI agent workplace today
summaryLinesEn: For this reason, I've deliberately taken a strategy to create 'versatilists.'" As AI completes repetitive and mundane work, Minahan said his versatilists should be comfortable applying their skills across many areas, such as discussions with business stakeholders to identify valuable digital transformation projects.

In the age of agentic AI, as suggested by Workday principal strategist Julie Colwell in a recent blog post , the rise of the polymath is associated with a shift in labor demand away from specialists who know everything about a single domain to professionals with knowledge across multiple disciplines.
"Specialists aren't required in most businesses anymore because AI leverages knowledge differently.

articles.title: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
articles.descEn: Nvidia has a plan to make sure its GPUs won't lose value. It wants to convince a new crop of financiers to keep lending for AI buildouts.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia's new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia announced this week that Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR were willing to commit up to $500 billion to build AI data centers.
The risk is that today’s AI boom, where demand far outstrips capacity, doesn’t continue for much longer.
Specifically, Nvidia is promising that if GPUs used as collateral don’t retain their value as expected, the company will cover up to 25% of the difference.

articles.title: Grok 4.6 is Out, Undercutting AI Prices of Rivals
articles.descEn: SpaceXAI’s lower-priced Grok 4.6 focuses on long-running agentic tasks.
articles.titleEn: Grok 4.6 is Out, Undercutting AI Prices of Rivals
summaryLinesEn: Grok 4.6 costs $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.
Introduced this week, a little over a month after Grok 4.5 , Grok 4.6 focuses more on long-running agents.
As the AI pricing war ramps up, Elon Musk’s SpaceXAI is aiming to prove to enterprises that it offers the most cost-efficient model with the release of Grok 4.6.

articles.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
articles.descEn: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
summaryLinesEn: Other features may temporarily disappear during the transition, Microsoft warns, and files generated by the stand-alone Copilot app will be migrated to OneDrive.

As initially reported by GeekWire and detailed in Microsoft’s support documentation , the tech giant will combine the functionality of its consumer-facing Copilot app and the more business-oriented Microsoft 365 Copilot app.

In July, The Information reported that Microsoft EVP Jacob Andreou, who oversees Copilot, said in an internal memo that the app needed to earn “the right to exist” in its customers’ lives, which required moving on from features that didn’t work.

articles.title: I tried the new ChatGPT Desktop App for Linux - but I'll stick to my browser for now
articles.descEn: This preview release of ChatGPT Desktop for Linux supports Ubuntu, Debian, and Fedora is here.
articles.titleEn: I tried the new ChatGPT Desktop App for Linux - but I'll stick to my browser for now
summaryLinesEn: According to OpenAI's Linux preview announcement, the desktop app is intended to serve as a workspace for projects, files, browser workflows, and Codex sessions.
The release also arrives roughly a month after Anthropic introduced a Linux desktop version of Claude .
Leaving aside ChatGPT's lack of accuracy, this release supports Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and 26.04 LTS, Debian 13, and Fedora 43 and 44 on both x86-64 and Arm64 machines.

articles.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash lands with coding gains and undercuts its three-week-old predecessor's price by 50%
articles.descEn: Google shipped Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after 3.6 Flash. The new model is supposed to be Google's most capable workhorse yet for coding and AI agents, and according to the company's own benchmarks, it beats Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-5.6 Terra at half the price.
articles.titleEn: Gemini 3.7 Flash lands with coding gains and undercuts its three-week-old predecessor's price by 50%
summaryLinesEn: Launch pricing sits at $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens, 50 percent cheaper than 3.6 Flash at launch.
On the FrontierCode benchmark , the model scores 43.6 percent, up from 34.4 percent.
On DeepSWE , it hits 65.3 percent versus 49.0 percent.

articles.title: Writer says its new Palmyra X6 model cuts AI agent costs by 52% as token spending surges
articles.descEn: Writer says its new Palmyra X6 model cuts AI agent costs by 52% as token spending surges VentureBeat
articles.titleEn: Writer says its new Palmyra X6 model cuts AI agent costs by 52% as token spending surges
summaryLinesEn: Inside Palmyra X6: how 626 training examples fine-tuned a 744-billion-parameter model Palmyra X6 is a 744-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with roughly 40 billion active parameters per token, inheriting GLM-5.2's architecture unchanged, according to Writer's technical report.

Why AI agents are blowing up enterprise budgets in ways chatbots never did Writer's announcement lands at a moment when the economics of agentic AI have moved to the center of enterprise buying decisions.
"The enterprise wants token consumption to explode — it means adoption is happening — but they need costs to flatten," said Waseem AlShikh, Writer's CTO and co-founder, in a statement.

summaryLines: Palmyra X6 내부 · 626개의 훈련 예제가 7,440억 매개변수 모델을 미세 조정한 방법 Palmyra X6는 토큰당 약 400억 개의 활성 매개변수가 있는 7,440억 매개변수 전문가 혼합 모델로, Writer의 기술 보고서에 따르면 GLM-5.2의 아키텍처를 변경 없이 상속함

Writer의 CTO이자 공동 창립자인 Waseem AlShikh는 성명에서 "기업은 토큰 소비가 폭발적으로 증가하기를 원함 · 이는 채택이 이루어지고 있음을 의미함 · 하지만 이를 평준화하려면 비용이 필요함" · 라고 말함

articles.title: Gemini 3.5 Pro Delay Continues
articles.descEn: Repeated Gemini 3.5 Pro delays fuel concerns about performance, competition, researcher departures, and Google’s AI strategy.
articles.titleEn: Gemini 3.5 Pro Delay Continues
summaryLinesEn: Here’s another wrinkle: as this project experiences enigmatic delays, Google engineers continue to report that AI is increasingly doing the work.
Rather than rush Pro, Google shipped the workhorse 3.6 Flash — described as improved coding/knowledge/multimodal at lower cost, using up to 65% fewer output tokens than 3.5 Flash.”

That sounds a lot like what has happened at Anthropic, with Project Glasswing , and OpenAI, as powerful models get corralled before being publicly launched, just because they’re too powerful to be out there roaming around.

summaryLines: 여기에 또 다른 문제점이 있음 · 이 프로젝트가 불가사의한 지연을 겪으면서 Google 엔지니어들은 AI가 점점 더 많은 작업을 수행하고 있다고 계속 보고하고 있음

articles.title: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Set up Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability for AI agents running outside AWS: on-premises, on GCP, on Azure, or on developer machines. This walkthrough uses the AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT) and IAM credentials to route session traces, span metrics, and token usage to the same AgentCore Observability dashboard.
articles.titleEn: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In this post, we show you how to set up observability for agents running outside AWS.

Although Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, provides native tracing, monitoring, and analytics that local cloud monitoring tools don’t offer out of the box, it natively supports only agents deployed on AgentCore runtime in the AWS Cloud.
This allows you to detect hallucinations, monitor for harmful or off-topic responses, track token usage for cost governance, and audit agent behavior across environments.

summaryLines: 이 게시물에서는 AWS 외부에서 실행되는 에이전트에 대한 관찰 가능성을 설정하는 방법을 보여줌

이를 통해 환각을 감지하고, 유해하거나 주제에서 벗어난 응답을 모니터링하고, 비용 거버넌스를 위한 토큰 사용을 추적하고, 환경 전반에 걸쳐 에이전트 동작을 감사할 수 있음

articles.title: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: What We Learned by Reproducing 2,200 papers from ICML
summaryLinesEn: In total, 3,978 individual claims were confirmed with real experiments. 23% of examined papers (496) had at least one claim falsified or contested.
Participants received $20 in Hugging Face compute credits to run experiments on HF Jobs ; across the challenge, participants launched 2,962 cloud jobs.

ICML 2026 received 23,918 submissions and accepted 6,352 papers , roughly double the previous year, continuing an exponential trend that is at least partly driven by AI agents making it faster to run experiments and write them up.

localization.title: ICML의 2,200개 논문을 재현하여 우리가 배운 것
summaryLines: 실제 실험을 통해 총 3,978건의 개별 주장이 확인됨 · 조사된 논문 중 23%(496개)에는 적어도 하나의 주장이 위조되거나 이의가 제기됨
참가자들은 HF Jobs에 대한 실험을 실행하기 위해 Hugging Face 컴퓨팅 크레딧으로 20달러를 받았음 · 챌린지 전반에 걸쳐 참가자들은 2,962개의 클라우드 일자리를 시작함
ICML 2026은 23,918개의 제출물을 접수하고 6,352개의 논문을 승인했는데, 이는 전년도의 약 두 배에 달하는 수치이며, 적어도 부분적으로는 AI 에이전트에 의해 실험 실행 및 작성 속도가 빨라지는 기하급수적인 추세를 이어가고 있음

articles.title: WRITER raises $100 million in Series B to deliver on generative AI for enterprises
articles.descEn: WRITER has raised $100 million in Series B funding to build the full-stack generative AI platform for enterprises. Find out what’s next.
articles.titleEn: WRITER raises $100 million in Series B to deliver on generative AI for enterprises
summaryLinesEn: I’m excited to announce that WRITER has raised $100 million in Series B funding!

Here are just a few examples of how customers create, analyze, and govern with WRITER to achieve significant business impact: 6sense increased their writing output by 50% and achieves 100% brand compliance on written content.

articles.descEn: Palmyra X6, a faster WRITER Agent, and new AI Studio governance — everything in this release helps GTM teams scale agentic work without runaway AI spend.
articles.titleEn: New at WRITER: Agentic work that scales without blowing the budget
summaryLinesEn: At the same time, enterprises are losing control of AI spend, burning through annual AI budgets in a matter of months and spending up to $500 million a month on uncapped AI.
The shift is from piloting agents to running them in production, across thousands of employees, with spend governed and aligned to ROI instead of left uncapped.
It’s engineered for the work most teams run every day: the high-volume personalization, research, and content work where marketing and sales teams need to scale without the bill running away.

articles.title: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Amazon on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
summaryLinesEn: To record on a physical SO-101, LeRobot's record CLI handles the leader-follower bring-up: The dataset lands on disk in the same format as the simulation recording, so the same sync call takes it to a bucket: sync_dataset_to_bucket("./recordings", "my-org/robot-fave", run_id="run-021") (or the hf sync ./recordings hf://buckets/my-org/robot-fave/run-021 CLI it wraps).

The first post in this series introduced Strands Robots , an open source SDK from AWS ( Apache 2.0 ) that exposes robot abstractions, simulation, and the LeRobot stack as AgentTools you compose into a single Strands agent.
Each of those decisions comes up dozens of times over a collection campaign, and each one needs a look at what came back before the next command goes out.

articles.title: Defense in depth in the age of agents
articles.descEn: At Sierra, we build agents using goals and guardrails so they can think and reason independently, whether originating a mortgage, disputing a charge, or helping select the right pair of skis. That freedom is what makes them so powerful — and the guardrails they are given so important.
articles.titleEn: Defense in depth in the age of agents
summaryLinesEn: Supervisors catch nuance that fixed rules can’t, but as agents themselves they share some of the limitations they’re built to detect.
Other threats involve bad content that should never appear in a conversation, regardless of who introduced it.
The basic idea of defense in depth — that you need layers — is the same, but agents change what those layers do.

articles.titleEn: Databricks wraps $5 billion funding round at $190 billion valuation
summaryLinesEn: The funding round comes six months after the private data analytics software company raised $5 billion in funding and $2 billion in new debt capacity at a $134 billion valuation.
The company said its Lakehouse data warehousing tool has surpassed a $1.5 billion run rate.
Founded in 2013, Databricks helps companies build AI agents and apps using proprietary data.

summaryLinesEn: Qualcomm announces Snapdragon C Platform for $300 and up laptops We went hands-on with Qualcomm's new '$300 and up' ARM laptop platform with mystery eight-core CPU Qualcomm aims Snapdragon C laptop chip at the budget laptop segment, as manufacturers feel the DRAM squeeze Qualcomm is promising designs from HP, Acer, Asus, and Lenovo.

articles.title: Google's Tensor G6 in Pixel 11 isn't a 2nm smartphone chip after all
articles.descEn: It was rumored that Google’s new Tensor G6, debuting in the Pixel 11, would be the first smartphone chip using...
articles.titleEn: Google's Tensor G6 in Pixel 11 isn't a 2nm smartphone chip after all
summaryLinesEn: Pixel 11 moves the NFC antenna to the top of the phone for easier payments, Tap to Share I can’t unsee the reason Pixel 11 Pro Fold is thinner, but it’s for the best [Gallery] Pixel 11 Pro displays are ‘more than twice’ as scratch-resistant – it only gets better from there Follow Ben: Twitter/X , Threads , Bluesky , and Instagram Update: Corrected headline – Tensor G6 was never the first 2nm smartphone chip, but the first using TSMC’s 2nm process.

Google’s new Tensor G6 chip isn’t without upgrades, though, with the company touting: Upgraded CPU with “25% faster web browsing, 15% quicker app launches” Upgraded Image Signal Processor powering faster Night Sight, further digital zoom TSMC’s 2nm process would have likely delivered efficiency upgrades for the most part, which has been rumored to be among Google’s key focus for this generation of chip.
It was rumored that Google’s new Tensor G6, debuting in the Pixel 11, would be the first smartphone chip using TSMC’s 2nm process, but it turns out that won’t be the case.

localization.title: Pixel 11의 Google Tensor G6은 결국 2nm 스마트폰 칩이 아님
summaryLines: Pixel 11은 간편한 결제를 위해 NFC 안테나를 모바일 상단으로 이동함 · 공유하려면 탭하세요 Pixel 11 Pro Fold가 더 얇아진 이유는 알 수 없지만 최고임 · [갤러리] Pixel 11 Pro 디스플레이는 긁힘 방지 성능이 '두 배 이상' 향상됨 · Ben 팔로우 · Twitter/X, Threads, Bluesky 및 Instagram 업데이트 · 헤드라인 수정 - Tensor G6는 최초의 2nm 스마트폰 칩이 아니었지만 최초의 2nm 스마트폰 칩은 아니었음 · TSMC의 2nm 공정을 사용함

하지만 Google의 새로운 Tensor G6 칩에는 업그레이드가 없음 · "25% 더 빠른 웹 검색, 15% 더 빠른 앱 실행"으로 업그레이드된 CPU 더 빠른 Night Sight, 추가 디지털 줌을 지원하는 업그레이드된 이미지 신호 프로세서 TSMC의 2nm 프로세스는 대부분의 경우 효율성 업그레이드를 제공했을 가능성이 높으며, 이는 Google이 이 세대 칩에 중점을 둔 것으로 소문난 소문임

summaryLinesKo: Pixel 11은 간편한 결제를 위해 NFC 안테나를 모바일 상단으로 이동함 · 공유하려면 탭하세요 Pixel 11 Pro Fold가 더 얇아진 이유는 알 수 없지만 최고임 · [갤러리] Pixel 11 Pro 디스플레이는 긁힘 방지 성능이 '두 배 이상' 향상됨 · Ben 팔로우 · Twitter/X, Threads, Bluesky 및 Instagram 업데이트 · 헤드라인 수정 - Tensor G6는 최초의 2nm 스마트폰 칩이 아니었지만 최초의 2nm 스마트폰 칩은 아니었음 · TSMC의 2nm 공정을 사용함

articles.title: Robot in a pocket: Honor’s new phone camera nods back at users
articles.descEn: The Chinese smartphone maker has integrated embodied AI to control camera movement, along with other features to boost interest amid a cooling market.
articles.titleEn: Robot in a pocket: Honor’s new phone camera nods back at users
summaryLinesEn: The Robot Phone is slated to go on sale in mainland China on Tuesday, with prices starting at 9,999 yuan (US$1,482), according to the company.

The Chinese smartphone maker has integrated embodied AI to control camera movement, along with other features to boost interest amid a cooling market Chinese smartphone maker Honor has launched a handset with a motorised robotic camera that nods back at users, betting that its interactive hardware will spark growth in a cooling global market for the devices.
It is designed to automatically pan and tilt the gimbal camera to keep users in the frame as they move about during phone calls or live streams.

articles.descEn: Process intelligence company Skan AI said today it raised $63 million in a Series C round to help further develop a platform that records how enterprise work actually gets done and feeds that record t
articles.titleEn: Skan AI raises $63M to give AI agents a map of enterprise work
summaryLinesEn: In one deployment at a large U.S. bank, Skan AI tracked 11.2 million context switches across 1,500 finance staff and surfaced $37 million in operational friction.

Agents built on those observations cut cost per transaction 32% and lifted throughput 41%, worth $18 million in annualized savings, according to the company.

articles.title: Researchers can now reverse-engineer LLM prompts from output text with near-perfect accuracy
articles.descEn: Researchers at IIT Bombay and Adobe Research have built an inverse language model that reconstructs the original prompt from an LLM's output with near-perfect accuracy. Their method, called "Previous-Token Prediction," doesn't need access to model weights and works across different models. For companies relying on proprietary system prompts, this could be a serious security risk.
articles.titleEn: Researchers can now reverse-engineer LLM prompts from output text with near-perfect accuracy
summaryLinesEn: Attackers don't even need to know which model produced the text An inverse model trained on the small Qwen-3-0.6B chatbot was also able to reconstruct prompts from GPT-4o's responses.
Researchers at IIT Bombay and Adobe Research have developed a method that can reconstruct prompts fed to large language models with near-perfect accuracy, using only the text output.
A new paper from researchers at IIT Bombay and Adobe Research shows it can be done with surprising accuracy.

articles.title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith's valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
articles.descEn: Blacksmith says revenue has grown more than tenfold over the past year.
articles.titleEn: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith's valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
summaryLinesEn: The startup now serves more than 5,000 customers, including Mercury, Supabase, Clerk, Ashby, and Expensify, up from more than 700 customers less than a year ago, co-founder and CEO Aditya Jayaprakash said in an exclusive interview.
Blacksmith has raised a new $45 million round to capitalize on that shift.
“Validating code is still a bottleneck, and it’s an even bigger bottleneck because people are writing even more,” Jayaprakash said.

But the framework is expected in the coming months to cover open models, too, a White House official tells Inner Loop .

But the White House has been coming under pressure from other parts of the administration, Inner Loop has learned, to draw up a more robust arrangement with leading AI labs because the current framework is still vague.

articles.title: Google's Gemini is losing market share to ChatGPT and Claude according to new market data
articles.descEn: Three data sources tell the same story: Google's Gemini is losing AI market share. Pangram reports a drop from 12 to 1.9 percent, while OpenAI holds over 50 percent, and Anthropic grew from 4.3 to 14.9 percent. Similarweb and OpenRouter confirm the trend.
articles.titleEn: Google's Gemini is losing market share to ChatGPT and Claude according to new market data
summaryLinesEn: Similarweb data shows Google's website market share dipped last month from 27 to 26.8 percent, though it was just 9.4 percent a year ago.
That could help explain the recent leadership shakeup at Google DeepMind , which saw several senior figures depart, including Demis Hassabis.
Gemini dropped from 12 percent to just 1.9 percent in July 2026, what Pangram calls a "collapse," also reflected in OpenRouter data .

articles.title: Google's Pixel Watch 5 gets offline Gemini support, improved GPS-tracking and a slightly higher price - Engadget
articles.descEn: The biggest additions on the Pixel Watch 5 are new health features.
articles.titleEn: Google's Pixel Watch 5 gets offline Gemini support, improved GPS-tracking and a slightly higher price - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The Pixel Watch 5 will start at $399 and any Golden State Warriors fan can expect to pay at least $579 for the Stephen Curry variant, both of which will be available for pre-order on August 12.

On the inside, you can expect mostly the same specs as the Pixel Watch 4, but Google did upgrade the chip to a Qualcomm Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated that provides a little boost in processing power.
Beyond blood pressure, the Pixel Watch 5 can also use its sensors to estimate insulin resistance and discover your "metabolic health," which Google describes as a "personal efficiency meter."
articles.summary:
The turning point comes when companies begin treating AI not as a pilot project but as an operating model with enterprise-scale consequences, according to Joe Fernandes , vice president and general manager of the Artificial Intelligence Business Unit at Red Hat Inc.
That shift is pushing organizations to rethink how much they should rely on public cloud AI services alone, especially as agentic systems move from simple assistants into persistent enterprise applications that act across business systems.
“I think that platform teams are more important than ever because this is the next layer of the enterprise platform, and agents are the next evolution of enterprise applications,” Fernandes said.

summaryLinesEn: As projects like Pacing the Frontier look to major labs as a way to keep AI research safe, open source models have become a sore spot for the industry .

“But my worry is because of all the lobbying in the U.S. and the fear-mongering, building open source AI in America is struggling to compete with open-weight models coming out of China, and my worry is that if China figures out a fundamentally more cost-efficient way to build AI, then things that are more cost-efficient have a fundamental business adoption advantage.”

If China’s open-weight models gained widespread adoption across Asia, Africa, and/or the developing world, he warned, they could influence how billions of people encountered ideas about democracy, freedom, and human rights.

localization.title: Agentic AI 인프라는 기업의 초점을 모델 선택에서 플랫폼 제어로 전환함
summaryLines: Pacing the Frontier와 같은 프로젝트가 AI 연구를 안전하게 유지하는 방법으로 주요 연구실을 고려함에 따라 오픈 소스 모델은 업계에서 골칫거리가 됨
"그러나 제가 걱정하는 것은 미국의 모든 로비와 두려움을 조장하는 것임 · 미국에서 오픈 소스 AI를 구축하는 것은 중국에서 나오는 개방형 모델과 경쟁하기 위해 고군분투하고 있음 · 그리고 중국이 AI를 구축하는 근본적으로 더 비용 효율적인 방법을 찾아낸다면, 더 비용 효율적인 것이 근본적인 비즈니스 채택 이점을 갖게 된다는 것임"
그는 중국의 개방형 모델이 아시아, 아프리카 및/또는 개발도상국 전역에 널리 채택된다면 수십억 명의 사람들이 민주주의, 자유, 인권에 대한 아이디어를 접하는 방식에 영향을 미칠 수 있다고 경고함

summaryLinesEn: For nearly two weeks, the company has denied the allegations , even as evidence piled up against it.

summaryLinesEn: Cognition, maker of the AI coding agent Devin, is reportedly already talking to investors about raising another funding round with a big leap in valuation, after it raised $1 billion at a $26 billon valuation in May.

articles.title: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic's new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
articles.descEn: Is Anthropic's new watermarking system a travesty? Some have taken to social media to complain that it is.
articles.titleEn: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic's new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
summaryLinesEn: Visionode’s basic argument appears to be that, while savvy Claude users may be able hide evidence of their AI usage by paraphrasing or otherwise cleaning their outputs through other AI services, the average user of Claude will be caught.

Anthropic rolled out this new policy to satisfy the EU AI Act’s Transparency Code , which now requires tech companies to label content that has been AI-generated or edited in a manner identifiable to computer systems.
Another unhappy camper called the watermarks “unethical” and “disgusting” and argued that by using Claude, they had done the lion’s share of the work.

Anthropic은 이제 기술 회사가 컴퓨터 시스템에서 식별할 수 있는 방식으로 AI로 생성되거나 편집된 콘텐츠에 라벨을 지정하도록 요구하는 EU AI Act의 투명성 규정을 충족하기 위해 이 새로운 정책을 발표함
또 다른 불행한 캠퍼는 워터마크를 "비윤리적"이고 "역겹다"고 말하며 Claude를 사용함으로써 작업의 가장 큰 몫을 수행했다고 주장함

articles.title: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
articles.descEn: Twitch users can now opt out of allowing their streams and other content to be used to train Amazon’s generative AI models. The toggle is available in settings.
articles.titleEn: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
summaryLinesEn: Turning this off does not opt you out of Twitch and Amazon using your channel content for other purposes described in the Twitch Privacy Notice, including using AI-supported Twitch features that benefit the community by facilitating streamer growth and monetization (such as real-time sponsorship campaign assistance), viewer discovery (such as recommendations), and community safety (such as AutoMod).

Opting out means that “your streams, VODs, clips, stream chats, and pictures and text on your channel” won’t be used in “future training” of an Amazon AI model “whose purpose is to generate or synthesize text, audio, images, or video,” according to a Twitch support page .
Follow Follow See All Tech Flip the new Twitch toggle if you don’t want your content to be used to train Amazon’s generative AI content models.

localization.title: 이제 Twitch 스트리머는 Amazon AI 교육을 거부할 수 있음
summaryLines: 이 기능을 끄더라도 스트리머 성장 및 수익화(예 · 실시간 후원 캠페인 지원), 시청자 검색(예 · 추천) 및 커뮤니티 안전(AutoMod 등)을 촉진하여 커뮤니티에 도움이 되는 AI 지원 Twitch 기능을 포함하여 Twitch 개인정보 보호정책에 설명된 다른 목적으로 채널 콘텐츠를 사용하는 경우 Twitch 및 Amazon 이용이 중단되지 않음
옵트아웃은 Twitch 지원 페이지에 따르면 "텍스트, 오디오, 이미지 또는 비디오를 생성하거나 합성하는 것이 목적인" Amazon AI 모델의 "향후 교육"에 "귀하의 스트림, VOD, 클립, 스트림 채팅, 채널의 사진 및 텍스트"가 사용되지 않는다는 것을 의미함
귀하의 콘텐츠가 Amazon의 생성 AI 콘텐츠 모델을 훈련하는 데 사용되는 것을 원하지 않으면 새로운 Twitch 토글을 뒤집으십시오

articles.title: Again acquires Geno to advance biomanufacturing at scale with AI design
articles.descEn: Denmark-based LuaBio ApS, operating as Again, today announced the acquisition of Genomatica Inc. to combine the company’s cutting-edge biomanufacturing capabilities with Geno’s artificial intellig
articles.titleEn: Again acquires Geno to advance biomanufacturing at scale with AI design
summaryLinesEn: Geno’s platform works for mass-scale industrial replacement and could prevent 85 million tons of carbon emissions annually; Again’s captures processes up to 1 ton of emissions per day.

Not only will this lower overall emissions and environmental stress — making regulators and people with lungs happier — but it will also recycle what was originally waste into more efficient revenue streams.
This includes its entire patent portfolio, which includes data spanning experimental results, structural and scale-up insights and developmental outcomes.

articles.title: SPONSORED: Sovereign AI overcomes compliance challenges and feeds innovation in public sector and other regulated industries, say HPE and NVIDIA
articles.descEn: Sovereign AI is becoming a strategic infrastructure priority
articles.titleEn: SPONSORED: Sovereign AI overcomes compliance challenges and feeds innovation in public sector and other regulated industries, say HPE and NVIDIA
summaryLinesEn: Pienaar and Shirhatti sit on the frontline of this shift in AI development.

The HPE Sovereign AI Factory lets customers in highly-regulated industries keep sensitive data, models, and operations under strict local control, using customized, validated infrastructure integrated with HPE services from deployment to operational support that helps customers with security, compliance, and control across infrastructure, data, and AI models.
But new mandates governing AI deployments also require them to act as careful custodians of their data, along with the infrastructure, supply chain, software and other aspects of their IT landscape.

articles.title: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands
articles.descEn: Discover our new sign-language-to-text (SL2T) translation model, bringing ASL dictation to Gboard and Live Transcribe on Pixel 11.
articles.titleEn: Putting sign language AI into users’ hands
summaryLinesEn: Yet this technological revolution has not reached the world’s more than 200 sign languages — and the estimated 70 million Deaf and hard of hearing people who use them.

We co-authored a joint impact report for the release of SL2T 1.0 in Gboard and Live Transcribe, transparently detailing the technology's capabilities and current limitations — a collaborative approach we plan to continue for all major sign language releases.
Similarly to how hearing users can use dictation to speak instead of typing, this feature enables Deaf users to sign to their phone anywhere they’d normally type.

We co-authored a joint impact report for the release of SL2T 1.0 in Gboard and Live Transcribe, transparently detailing the technology's capabilities and current limitations — a collaborative approach we plan to continue for all major sign language releases.

articles.titleEn: AT&T Expands Video Intelligence Portfolio with EdgeVis Cloud
summaryLinesEn: From the first phone call 150 years ago to our 5G wireless and multi-gig internet offerings today, we @ATT innovate to improve lives.

EdgeVis Cloud supports growing demand for video-enabled operations across enterprise, mid-market, large SMB, and public sector organizations as they increasingly rely on video for safety, security, and near real-time situational awareness.

summaryLines: 150년 전 최초의 전화 통화부터 오늘날의 5G 무선 및 멀티 기가비트 인터넷 서비스에 이르기까지, @ATT는 삶의 질을 개선하기 위해 혁신을 이루고 있음
EdgeVis Cloud는 안전, 보안 및 거의 실시간 상황 인식을 위해 비디오에 점점 더 의존하고 있는 기업, 중간 규모 시장, 대규모 SMB 및 공공 부문 조직 전반에서 비디오 지원 운영에 대한 수요 증가를 지원함
AT&T Business는 오늘 조직이 배포 복잡성과 인프라 요구 사항을 줄이면서 광범위한 운영 환경에서 실시간 비디오 모니터링을 확장 및 관리할 수 있도록 설계된 새로운 관리형 클라우드 배포 옵션인 EdgeVis Cloud가 포함된 AT&T Video Intelligence를 출시함

articles.title: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
articles.descEn: NVIDIA announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA AI Factory Compute Is Becoming an Investable Asset Class
summaryLinesEn: Blackwell capacity commands a premium, with reported B200 cloud rates spanning approximately $5.30 to $7.05 per GPU-hour.

We have moved from an era in which companies bought chips and built data centers project by project to one in which AI factories can be financed as productive infrastructure — with repeatable platforms, long-term institutional capital and a diverse customer base that uses compute to create revenue.

We announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to establish independent financing platforms designed to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to support the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.

summaryLines: Blackwell 용량은 GPU 시간당 약 5.30~7.05달러에 달하는 보고된 B200 클라우드 요금으로 프리미엄을 요구함

우리는 Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs 및 KKR과의 파트너십을 발표하여 시간이 지남에 따라 AI 인프라 구축을 지원하기 위해 5,000억 달러 이상의 제3자 자본을 동원하도록 설계된 독립적인 금융 플랫폼을 구축함

articles.descEn: China’s smartphone sales declined 8.6% YoY in the first 30 weeks of 2026, with the decline returning to double digits after the 618 shopping festival amid seasonal weakness and continued memory cost…
articles.titleEn: China Smartphone Market Saw Sharper Contraction After 618
summaryLinesEn: China’s smartphone sales declined 8.6% YoY in the first 30 weeks of 2026 amid persistently weak demand, according to Counterpoint Research’s China Weekly Smartphone Sell-Out Tracker .

In addition, OPPO’s three brands are undergoing consolidation across regions, product positioning, after-sales services and software systems, with short-term challenges expected during the transition.

China’s smartphone sales declined 8.6% YoY in the first 30 weeks of 2026, with the decline returning to double digits after the 618 shopping festival amid seasonal weakness and continued memory cost inflation.

중국의 스마트폰 판매량은 2026년 첫 30주 동안 전년 동기 대비 8.6% 감소했으며, 계절적 비수기 및 지속적인 메모리 비용 인플레이션으로 인해 618 쇼핑 페스티벌 이후 감소율이 두 자릿수로 회복됨

articles.title: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
articles.descEn: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang is ranked No. 1 on Glassdoor’s Best CEOs list for 2026. In the just-released ranking, recognition is earned directly from the people who know their leadership the best — employees. Huang topped the list, with 99% of employees approving of the job he does. “As AI and shifting expectations […]
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
summaryLinesEn: This award recognizes CEOs “who are leading with empathy, clarity and purpose” at a time when workers are navigating increased uncertainty in the job market, according to Glassdoor, which analyzes employee ratings and reviews to identify the leaders who have earned the highest levels of employee approval and trust.
“As AI and shifting expectations redefine the modern workplace, exceptional leadership has never been more vital,” Glassdoor noted.

Glassdoor reintroduced the Best CEOs list this year after a hiatus of five years, replacing the Best-Led Companies list, which ranked NVIDIA at No. 1 in 2025, in a shift to sharpen the focus on CEO and executive leadership and its impact on employee experience and company reputation.

summaryLinesEn: On the call, Jamie retrieves the saved application, confirms a few details, pulls the final quote, and answers her follow-up questions live.

articles.title: Scaling AI agents with trustworthy data
articles.descEn: Business and technology leaders need no convincing that the time of agentic AI is here. Organizations are rapidly adopting agents, and few executives doubt the technology’s potential to transform work. But many organizations find that realizing the desired return on investment (ROI) from AI hinges on having the right foundation, with inadequate infrastructure and data…
articles.titleEn: Scaling AI agents with trustworthy data
summaryLinesEn: But many organizations find that realizing the desired return on investment (ROI) from AI hinges on having the right foundation, with inadequate infrastructure and data being major blockers .

To make decisions and act in real time, agents also need frictionless access to the organization’s operational systems—for example, those storing its supply chain, point-of-sale, or human resources data.
The shift from answering questions to taking actions means AI agents need data from across the enterprise, in all its structured and unstructured forms, and with the right business context.

articles.title: Is Agentic AI Pricing Getting Better? What’s Coming Next
articles.descEn: Pricing for enterprise agentic AI continues to be too complex, but the author has ideas about likely forthcoming improvements — and what enterprises should do now.
articles.titleEn: Is Agentic AI Pricing Getting Better? What’s Coming Next
summaryLinesEn: However, given the volatility of pricing and the increased number of reports of surprise billing, better tooling is not enough.

The first issue is a lack of usable adoption metrics, though there are multiple factors that suggest headway can be made: forward-deployed engineering initiatives, reduced roadmap churn, credits- and action-based pricing, and better cost controls should provide the right signals to improve the current state.
You also need staff who have a deep understanding of how agent costing works and what guardrails need to be in place to mitigate risk and encourage the right adoption patterns.

또한 에이전트 비용 산정 방식과 위험을 완화하고 올바른 채택 패턴을 장려하기 위해 어떤 가드레일을 마련해야 하는지에 대해 깊이 이해하고 있는 직원이 필요함

articles.title: Google’s Gemini AI app passes 1 billion monthly active users
articles.descEn: Google LLC’s Gemini artificial intelligence app has passed 1 billion monthly active users, making it the 14th product in the company’s history to reach that mark.The company announced the mile
articles.titleEn: Google’s Gemini AI app passes 1 billion monthly active users
summaryLinesEn: The app has more than 100 million active users on iOS, and Google said power users on macOS prompt about twice as often as users on other surfaces.
A meaningful share of those monthly actives therefore arrived through a default rather than a deliberate download.

The distinction matters more than usual this year, given that Alphabet has raised its 2026 capital spending forecast to between $195 billion and $205 billion, much of it going toward the infrastructure that serves models such as Gemini.

articles.title: A New Trick Reveals AI Models’ Inner Thoughts
articles.descEn: Researchers devised a way to extract “reasoning traces” from Claude, GPT, and Gemini. What they found, they say, indicates that some Chinese AI may be trained on leading US models.
articles.titleEn: A New Trick Reveals AI Models’ Inner Thoughts
summaryLinesEn: “All major frontier model providers we tested share this vulnerability,” says Alexander Panfilov,⁩ a computer scientist at University of Tübingen in Germany who was involved with the work.

The findings provide some evidence—although not conclusive proof—that certain Chinese models may have been trained by “ distilling ” reasoning information from US models that was supposedly hidden because of how closely some of their thinking or reasoning patterns seem to match.
Lately, however, distillation has become a controversial topic, because of claims that Chinese AI companies use it to essentially copy the best US models.

summaryLines: 이 작업에 참여한 독일 튀빙겐 대학의 컴퓨터 과학자 Alexander Panfilov는 "우리가 테스트한 모든 주요 개척 모델 제공업체는 이 취약점을 공유하고 있습니다"라고 말함
이번 조사 결과는 비록 결정적인 증거는 아니지만 일부 중국 모델이 사고 또는 추론 패턴이 얼마나 밀접하게 일치하는지 때문에 숨겨졌을 것으로 추정되는 미국 모델의 추론 정보를 '정제'하여 훈련했을 수 있다는 몇 가지 증거를 제공함
그러나 최근 중국 AI 기업이 증류법을 이용해 미국 최고의 모델을 모방한다는 주장이 제기되면서 증류법이 논란의 대상이 됨

articles.title: AI Is Dead. Organoids Are Alive
articles.descEn: Mini human brains are being grown in labs all over the world. Soon, they could outthink neural networks.
articles.titleEn: AI Is Dead. Organoids Are Alive
summaryLinesEn: Muotri’s organoids contain 5 million cells, of which 2.5 million are neurons.
It’s about as significant a paradigm shift as I can imagine for computing: No matter how badly you mess up your code, things on the computer don’t normally die in real life .
Each is the size of an elongated toaster and boasts an onboard life-support system capable of keeping a culture of up to a million neurons alive for six months.

articles.title: Authors face backlash for participation in 2022 Google AI study - Engadget
articles.descEn: Thirteen authors joined a little-known Google AI study in 2022. Now they're facing backlash.
articles.titleEn: Authors face backlash for participation in 2022 Google AI study - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: (Participants in the Wordcraft Writers Workshop declined to tell Engadget how much they were compensated for the study; Google has not responded to a request for comment.)
An internal study was launched to determine whether AI could serve as a brainstorming assistant, researcher or writing collaborator for professional writers.

Flashpoints like this one are indicative of AI's impact on the arts, and while it may seem unfair to retroactively hold these 13 authors to rapidly-evolving moral standards, some of the chastised participants in the Wordcraft study have arrived at the same conclusion as Lachance regardless.

articles.title: Spotify will label 'AI Persona' profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
articles.descEn: Spotify is introducing “AI Persona” labels for artist profiles that represent AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.
articles.titleEn: Spotify will label 'AI Persona' profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
summaryLinesEn: Like others in the music industry, Spotify is attempting to balance innovations driven by AI, like its own AI-powered Prompted Playlists , AI DJ , and chat , and forthcoming AI remixes, while still managing to thwart the deluge of AI-generated slop — low-quality content that AI has made it easier to mass-produce.
Spotify will begin labeling AI-generated artists with “AI Persona” profile tags and ban their music from its editorial and algorithmic recommendations, the company announced on Tuesday.

By default, Spotify won’t include AI Personas in its editorial or algorithmic recommendations, nor will it add AI Personas’ music to users’ personalized recommendations — unless they happen to follow an AI Persona.

articles.title: Spotify says it won’t recommend music from ‘AI Personas’
articles.descEn: Spotify will label artists as “AI Personas” if their identities appear to be AI-generated. The music streaming platform will also remove music from AI Personas from personalized recommendations.
articles.titleEn: Spotify says it won’t recommend music from ‘AI Personas’
summaryLinesEn: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough Costco’s great Switch 2 console bundle includes over $100 in free stuff Anker’s travel charger works in almost any country and is down to $20 What to expect from Google’s 2026 Pixel hardware launch event

While Spotify currently doesn’t have a system to identify AI-generated music like Deezer , it allows artists to disclose AI use and launched a “Verified by Spotify” badge to indicate that they’re a real person.
The change, which will start rolling out in mid-September , means you’ll see an “AI Persona” badge on an artist’s profile across the app if they do “not represent a real person.”

articles.title: Anthropic signs $9.1 billion data center deal with Bitcoin miner Riot Platforms
articles.descEn: Anthropic is leasing $9.1 billion worth of data center capacity from Bitcoin miner Riot Platforms in Texas, according to Bloomberg. The deal covers 191 megawatts at Riot's Rockdale site, with extension options that could push the total value to $16.1 billion. It's the latest in an aggressive infrastructure push that spans partners from Amazon to SpaceX to Google.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic signs $9.1 billion data center deal with Bitcoin miner Riot Platforms
summaryLinesEn: The company is paying SpaceX an estimated $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 for the Colossus 1 data center and plans to deploy two gigawatts of AMD GPUs .
The lease runs 20 years, with two extension options that could push the total value to $16.1 billion.
Amazon is investing up to $25 billion and building up to five gigawatts of Trainium capacity with Anthropic.

articles.title: Anthropic watermarks all Claude outputs globally with marks that "may persist through some editing"
articles.descEn: Anthropic will embed invisible watermarks in all Claude-generated text and sign files using the C2PA standard. New models shipping from August 2026 onward will have labeling built in from day one. The policy applies worldwide, and Anthropic plans to provide detection tools for third-party verification.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic watermarks all Claude outputs globally with marks that "may persist through some editing"
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI has been sitting on a text detector with 99.9 percent accuracy for about two years and still hasn't released it.
Existing models get a transition period under the law, but Anthropic says it's already working on retrofitting them.
Text watermarks should also work through cloud partners such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry, though those platforms may not support signed metadata.

articles.title: Nvidia guarantees its own chips' value to unlock $500 billion in AI infrastructure financing
articles.descEn: Nvidia is teaming up with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion for AI infrastructure. To win over investors, the chipmaker is guaranteeing up to 25 percent of the residual value of its own hardware. The Bank of England is already warning of systemic risks if the AI sector takes a hit.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia guarantees its own chips' value to unlock $500 billion in AI infrastructure financing
summaryLinesEn: According to the Financial Times , which broke the deal, Nvidia's stock dropped about 1.4 percent afterward, wiping out more than $70 billion in market cap.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang described the move on X as a shift from one-off projects to repeatable financing platforms.

Burry argued that GPUs become obsolete too fast for five-to-seven-year useful lives because of Nvidia's two-to-three-year upgrade cycle, and that depreciation would be understated by roughly $176 billion between 2026 and 2028 alone.

articles.title: The AI takeover of mathematics has begun
articles.descEn: OpenAI showed that AI can tackle long-standing problems in mathematics. Experts are excited about the possibilities — and worried about what comes next for their field.
articles.titleEn: The AI takeover of mathematics has begun
summaryLinesEn: Kun, a researcher at the Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics in Hungary, told The Verge OpenAI reached out to him by email shortly before publishing to share its findings.

He had just returned from a four-week AI and mathematics research conference in South Korea, where he said many felt there had been something of a “phase transition” over the past six months, with AI producing genuine and meaningful advances.
OpenAI estimates that generating Astra’s 10 solutions would have cost around $2,000 in tokens at the current API prices for its Sol model.

articles.descEn: The Zoom vulnerability allowed hackers to take over everyone’s device on a call, security researchers say.
articles.titleEn: ‘Zoomsday’ hack uncovered using fewer than 20 AI prompts
summaryLinesEn: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough Costco’s great Switch 2 console bundle includes over $100 in free stuff Anker’s travel charger works in almost any country and is down to $20 What to expect from Google’s 2026 Pixel hardware launch event
In a blog post on Tuesday , researchers at A Security say they uncovered the flaw using “fewer than 20 prompts on publicly available AI models,” as reported earlier by Wired .
The attack required no action from victims and showed “no visual cue indicating the compromise,” according to A Security.

articles.titleEn: How to create flyers with AI that people won't hate: 8 tips (and prompts) that really work

articles.title: Why software factories are back - and how they work in the age of AI
articles.descEn: Imagine submitting your vibe-coded app to a service that validates, tests, and then mass-produces it in a repeatable, automated fashion for delivery to a wide audience.
articles.titleEn: Why software factories are back - and how they work in the age of AI
summaryLinesEn: "Over the past 18 months or so, many of the companies that are on the cutting edge of using agents to automate their software development life cycle have been building the same machine, and independently coming to the same conclusion on what this machine looks like," according to Jaymin West, a forward-deployed engineer and technology evangelist, in a recent YouTube video .
"Developer craftsmanship is not going away, as devs and engineers shift from writing code to exercising judgment around what gets built and shipped."
Of course, software factories, no matter how efficient, are not a panacea for good software practices.

articles.title: OpenAI introduces $125 Premium Seats for ChatGPT Business as agentic AI burns through more tokens
articles.descEn: OpenAI is rolling out "Premium Seats" for ChatGPT Business customers at $125 per user per month, five times the price of the existing Standard Seats. In return, users get significantly more capacity and no five-hour usage limit. The move signals that the flat-rate pricing AI providers have offered so far was never going to last.

summaryLinesEn: The existing standard seats stay at $25 per month ($20 with annual billing).
The company is rolling out so-called Premium Seats , which cost $125 per user per month, or $100 with annual billing.
OpenAI says the change reflects how teams are tackling more complex tasks with ChatGPT and need more capacity.

articles.title: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
articles.descEn: Security researchers found a vulnerability in the APIs of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google that lets them extract encrypted reasoning traces and move them between models. A scan of public sessions turned up dozens of passwords and API keys. The traces also show that the reasoning summaries users see often hide what the models are actually doing.
articles.titleEn: "But marinade" and leaked passwords are what researchers found in ChatGPT's hidden reasoning
summaryLinesEn: A scan of roughly 7,000 public traces turned up 62 API keys, 33 email addresses, 33 passwords, and other sensitive data.
The concept has been well studied: In their thought processes, models explicitly consider cheating but (possibly) decide against it because they expect to get caught.
A memorization analysis showed that specific Claude and GPT reasoning segments are up to six orders of magnitude easier to extract from Kimi-K3 than from the next closest model.

articles.title: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
articles.descEn: OpenAI’s chatbot hit the milestone a few weeks ago, and Google just announced its own billionth user on Tuesday.
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
summaryLinesEn: Google, meanwhile, announced in February that Gemini had 750 million monthly users, before reporting 950 million in late July on its earnings call, and Google spokesperson Alex Joseph says it reached 1 billion last week before announcing it today.
The AI race in general has tightened significantly this year.

The Gemini that comes preinstalled on Android phones seemingly does, though, which is a huge win for Google — Gemini chief Josh Woodward posted that Gemini has more than 100 million active users on iOS, which would mean by extension that the vast majority of Gemini users are also Android users.
articles.summary:
Mistral raised €830 million ($962 million) in debt earlier this year to fund its data center near Paris, TechCrunch reported in March, and pre-committed enterprise demand is exactly what makes that kind of financing repeatable at ten times the scale.
Taken together, the announcements mark a decisive shift in how Mistral positions itself.
McKinsey has estimated that meeting global AI demand could require $5.2 trillion in data-center capital expenditure by 2030 — and Europe, by most analyses, is starting from behind.

articles.descEn: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

summaryLinesEn: Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.

articles.title: China's Humanoid Robot Lead Is Misleading. Here's Why
articles.descEn: China's winning the battle. The real war for humanoid robot dominance has yet to really begin, however.
articles.titleEn: China's Humanoid Robot Lead Is Misleading. Here's Why
summaryLinesEn: Global humanoid robot shipments jumped 272% year-over-year in the first half of 2026, reaching 19,100 units, according to a new report from Smart Analytics Global.

"Global humanoid robot shipments nearly quadrupled in 1H 2026, but an equally important shift is taking place in how these robots are being deployed," said Linda Sui, founder and principal at Smart Analytics Global, in the report.
Scaling too late is a massive risk too: competitors may eat up the market before you get there.

articles.title: Figma Q2 Earnings Call Puts AI Monetization Broadening in Focus
articles.descEn: FIG raises its 2026 revenue outlook as AI credit use broadens, while Q3 guidance and beta-product costs keep monetization and margins in focus.
articles.titleEn: Figma Q2 Earnings Call Puts AI Monetization Broadening in Focus
summaryLinesEn: CFO Praveer Melwani said more than 80% of paid customers with over $10,000 in ARR were consuming AI credits weekly.
Melwani said non-GAAP gross profit rose 40% year over year to $314 million, while non-GAAP gross margin reached 85%, up 2.5 percentage points sequentially.
Management maintained full-year non-GAAP operating income guidance of $125-$135 million, equal to a 9% operating margin at the midpoint, despite raising revenue guidance.

articles.title: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
articles.descEn: WeatherNext enables accurate cyclone forecasts that can give an extra day of warning. Now we are open sourcing the model.
articles.titleEn: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
summaryLinesEn: Tropical cyclones — also known as hurricanes or typhoons — are among the most destructive weather phenomena on Earth, responsible for more than 700,000 deaths and $1.4 trillion in economic losses globally over the past 50 years.
You can explore our latest cyclone forecasts on Weather Lab , which we recently refreshed with a new interface and expanded to include global weather forecasts alongside cyclone tracks.

By making this technology openly available, we hope to empower the research community and amplify AI's impact in building more resilient communities – whether that be providing local forecasters with the tools they need to prepare for natural disasters , supporting the growth of renewable energy, or anticipating extreme weather.

Weather Lab에서 최신 사이클론 예측을 탐색할 수 있음 · 최근 새로운 인터페이스로 새롭게 단장되었으며 사이클론 트랙과 함께 전 세계 일기 예보를 포함하도록 확장됨
이 기술을 공개적으로 제공함으로써 우리는 지역 예보관에게 자연 재해에 대비하는 데 필요한 도구를 제공하거나, 재생 가능 에너지 성장을 지원하거나, 극한 기후를 예측하는 등 연구 커뮤니티에 힘을 실어주고 보다 탄력적인 커뮤니티를 구축하는 데 AI의 영향력을 증폭시키기를 희망함

articles.title: Mapping the AI economy
articles.descEn: AI companies are undergoing rapid global expansion while achieving unprecedented rates of growth. We analyzed Stripe data to understand where global demand is the strongest, and how companies can build to best capture that demand.
articles.titleEn: Mapping the AI economy
summaryLinesEn: As the revenue infrastructure provider for thousands of AI companies, including 88% of the 2026 Forbes AI 50, Stripe data offers a unique view of the AI economy.

The fastest-growing AI companies on Stripe already use 2x more local payment methods on average than the broader cohort, and previous analyses have shown that surfacing relevant local payment methods can have a significant impact on conversion (up 7.4% on average) and revenue (up 12% on average).
As AI companies reach the ceiling of global expansion (there are only so many countries in the world), sustaining growth will require laying roots in the places they’ve launched.

articles.title: Sensor Tower Top 10 Worldwide Mobile Games - July 2026
articles.descEn: Sensor Tower’s mobile gaming recap for July 2026 highlights the latest releases, rising stars, and breakout games around the world.

summaryLinesEn: Global consumer spending on mobile games across the App Store and Google Play reached $6.6 billion in July , up 7.7% month-over-month .

articles.title: Advanced Audience Insights | Income, Gender, Age & More
articles.descEn: Sensor Tower's audience analytics tool demystifies consumer demographics and behavior. Access reports on income, gender, age, persona, and more.
articles.titleEn: Advanced Audience Insights | Income, Gender, Age & More
summaryLinesEn: Audience Insights has always revolved around three core areas of exploration: → what ads they’re exposed to (top channels, categories, and brands) Plus, the ability to compare up to five different audience segments side-by-side , rather than toggling between tabs.
Now imagine you’re an advertiser with limited budget, and you need to decide which platform to invest on for your next campaign.
With this Audience Insights-exclusive feature , you can see not just who’s engaging with an app, but their spending power as well.
