articles.descEn: New Mobile Economy Asia Pacific 2026 report highlights the opportunities and policy priorities that will shape the region’s next phase of digital growth 6 August 2026, Kuala Lumpur: Mobile technologies and services are projected to contribute US$1.4 trillion to the Asia Pacific economy by 2030, a 40% increase from the US$1 trillion generated today, according to the […]
articles.titleEn: GSMA Report: Mobile Industry to Contribute US$1.4 Trillion to Asia Pacific Economy by 2030 as Digital Trust, AI, Digital Sovereignty and Resilience Take Centre Stage at M360 ASEAN
summaryLinesEn: New Mobile Economy Asia Pacific 2026 report highlights the opportunities and policy priorities that will shape the region’s next phase of digital growth 6 August 2026, Kuala Lumpur: Mobile technologies and services are projected to contribute US$1.4 trillion to the Asia Pacific economy by 2030, a 40% increase from the US$1 trillion generated today, according to the GSMA’s new Mobile Economy Asia Pacific 2026 report.

The event will feature keynote addresses and discussions involving senior leaders including: The Right Honourable Datuk Amar Haji Fadillah bin Haji Yusof, Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia and Minister of Energy Transition and Water Transformation; Dian Siswarini, President Director, Telkom Indonesia; and Bhupinder Singh, President, Vodafone Business International.

These leaders will join policymakers, industry executives and technology innovators from across the region to discuss how ASEAN can strengthen digital trust, accelerate AI-enabled growth, support digital sovereignty and build resilient digital infrastructure for the future.

articles.title: CPUs are having a moment: Inside Arm's hyperscale surge
articles.descEn: See how Microsoft Cobalt and AWS Graviton prove Arm-based CPUs for AI infrastructure are becoming central to hyperscale cloud growth.
articles.titleEn: CPUs are having a moment: Inside Arm's hyperscale surge
summaryLinesEn: A day later, Amazon reported its chips business (Graviton, Trainium and Nitro combined) had blown past a $25 billion annual revenue run rate, growing triple digits year over year.

The $25 billion run rate covers the whole chips business, not Graviton alone, but faster commitments and quicker Graviton5 uptake show a custom CPU line pulling real weight inside a large, fast-growing silicon platform, while giving customers a hard price-performance reason to shift more workloads over.
CFO Amy Hood credited efficiency gains across both the CPU and GPU fleets — plus faster infrastructure turn-up — for capacity that got monetized almost as fast as it came online.

summaryLines: 하루 후 Amazon은 자사의 칩 사업(Graviton, Trainium 및 Nitro 합산)이 연간 250억 달러의 매출을 기록하며 전년 대비 세 자릿수 성장을 기록했다고 보고함
250억 달러의 실행 속도는 Graviton 단독이 아닌 전체 칩 비즈니스를 포괄하지만, 더 빠른 약속과 더 빠른 Graviton5 활용은 빠르게 성장하는 대형 실리콘 플랫폼 내에서 실제 무게를 끌어내는 맞춤형 CPU 라인을 보여주며 고객에게 더 많은 작업 부하를 전환할 수 있는 확실한 가격 대비 성능 이유를 제공함
CFO인 Amy Hood는 CPU와 GPU 전체에 걸쳐 효율성이 향상되고 인프라 가동 시간이 빨라짐에 따라 용량이 온라인에 등장하는 속도만큼 빠르게 수익을 창출할 수 있었다고 평가함

articles.title: Agency: Secure, scalable sandboxes for agents
articles.descEn: The hardest part of building great agents isn't the model — it's everything around it. That’s where Agency comes in, the infrastructure that gives every Pinecone session and every task for Ghostwriter (our agent-building agent for customers) a secure place to live and run.
articles.titleEn: Agency: Secure, scalable sandboxes for agents
summaryLinesEn: Ease of use: We wanted users spending their time on high-leverage decisions — not on figuring out how to be productive in a different system with different limitations.
Before Pinecone, it wasn't unusual to see engineers walking around the office with half-open laptops — not because they were working, but because their AI agents were.
The stateful runner layer is where the agentic environment lives and is composed of all the on-demand pods created by the control plane.

localization.title: 에이전시 · 에이전트를 위한 안전하고 확장 가능한 샌드박스
summaryLines: 사용 용이성 · 우리는 사용자가 다양한 제한 사항이 있는 다른 시스템에서 생산성을 높이는 방법을 찾는 것이 아니라 중요한 결정에 시간을 투자하기를 원함
Pinecone 이전에는 엔지니어들이 반쯤 열린 노트북을 들고 사무실을 돌아다니는 것을 흔히 볼 수 있었음 · 이는 그들이 일을 하고 있기 때문이 아니라 AI 에이전트가 있었기 때문이었음
상태 저장 실행기 계층은 에이전트 환경이 존재하는 곳이며 컨트롤 플레인에서 생성된 모든 주문형 포드로 구성됨

articles.title: A guide to slash commands in the GitHub Copilot app
articles.descEn: Go beyond chat in the GitHub Copilot app with these slash commands. They'll help you plan, collaborate, automate, and customize your dev workflow.
articles.titleEn: A guide to slash commands in the GitHub Copilot app
summaryLinesEn: In the GitHub Copilot app, slash commands take that idea further, giving you shortcuts for managing sessions, navigating projects, and customizing your Copilot workflow.
A single / opens up the list of slash commands that can help you move faster, explore new ideas, and get the most out of the app.
File access commands like /add-dir or /cwd aren’t needed since the app manages project context automatically.

articles.title: [사설] 中 통신사 AI 토큰, 배울 바 크다
articles.descEn: 중국 3대 통신사가 인공지능(AI) 토큰 비즈니스를 통해 실질적 성과까지 내고 있음은 곧바로 우리에게 시사하는 바 크다. 본지 취재를 종합하면 올해 1분기 차이나모바일, 차이나텔레콤, 차이나유니콤이 거둔 토큰 관련 매출은 총 98억 위안(약 2조 원)에 달한다. 개인 가입자 3950만명, 기업 고객 10만6000곳을 확보하며 AI 사용량을 통신 상품처럼 계량·과금·정산하는 '토큰 이코노미'의 수익성을 증명해 낸 것이다. 통신 요금과 AI 서비

summaryLines: 20년 넘게 심각한 청력 손실을 안고 살아온 샌디에이고 출신의 Karen Walter(84세)는 오로지 라이브 캡션 기능을 위해 이 안경을 구입함
사람들은 내가 그런 걸 예상했어야 했다고 말했지만 나는 스파이 행위가 아니기 때문에 동의하지 않았다”고 말함
일부 사용자는 웨어러블이 삶을 변화시켰다고 말하지만 비평가들은 안전과 개인정보 보호에 대한 우려를 표명함 · 2025년에 700만 쌍 이상이 판매된 것으로 알려진 Meta의 Ray-Ban 스마트글라스는 빠르게 세계에서 가장 인기 있는 기기 중 하나로 자리잡고 있음

articles.title: Chinese humanoid robot maker Unitree prices IPO at $9 billion valuation
articles.descEn: The IPO comes as the U.S. and China ratchet up trade ​and technology tensions, with Washington tightening Chinese access to U.S. technology and markets.
articles.titleEn: Chinese humanoid robot maker Unitree prices IPO at $9 billion valuation
summaryLinesEn: China's Unitree has priced its Shanghai initial public offering at 150.8 yuan ($22.34) per share, valuing the company at around 61 billion yuan ($9.04 billion), it said on Thursday, in a deal that would make it the country's first mainland-listed maker of humanoid robots.
IPO subscriptions are due to open on August 10 and Unitree plans to use the proceeds to develop robot software and hardware, launch new products and build a manufacturing base, the prospectus showed.

Overall revenue more than quadrupled to 1.7 billion yuan in 2025 with humanoid robots generating 867.8 million yuan in sales and overtaking four-legged robots as Unitree's largest business, according to the prospectus.

localization.title: 중국 휴머노이드 로봇 제조사 Unitree, IPO를 90억 달러 가치로 평가
summaryLines: 중국 유니트리(Unitree)는 상하이 기업공개 가격을 주당 150.8위안(22.34달러)으로 평가했으며 회사 가치를 약 610억 위안(90억 4000만 달러)으로 평가했다고 목요일 밝힘 · 이 거래를 통해 중국 최초의 본토 상장 휴머노이드 로봇 제조업체가 될 것이라고 함
IPO 청약은 8월 10일에 시작될 예정이며 Unitree는 수익금을 로봇 소프트웨어 및 하드웨어 개발, 신제품 출시 및 제조 기반 구축에 사용할 계획이라고 투자설명서에 나와 있음
투자설명서에 따르면 휴머노이드 로봇이 8억 6,780만 위안의 매출을 올리고 4족 로봇을 제치고 Unitree의 최대 사업으로 전체 매출은 2025년 17억 위안으로 4배 이상 증가함

articles.title: Figma (FIG) Beats On AI Revenue, Is The Stock A Bargain?
articles.descEn: Why Figma Stock Is In Focus After Its Latest Earnings Figma (FIG) is drawing fresh attention after its second quarter 2026 earnings, where revenue exceeded consensus estimates, AI tools contributed new monetization, and management raised full year revenue guidance despite higher AI related costs pressuring margins. See our latest analysis for Figma. Despite Figma lifting full year revenue guidance after its August 5 results, the stock fell about 15% on the day, which reflects investor concern...
articles.titleEn: Figma (FIG) Beats On AI Revenue, Is The Stock A Bargain?
summaryLinesEn: Despite Figma lifting full year revenue guidance after its August 5 results, the stock fell about 15% on the day, which reflects investor concern about higher AI related costs.
However, Figma investors still need to weigh the risk that heavy AI spending and rising competition in design and developer tools could slow revenue growth and pressure margins.
Figma closed at $23.97, while the most widely followed narrative pegs fair value closer to $30.40, which puts a spotlight on what is driving that gap.

articles.descEn: Google's updated Chrome support documentation to show that you need about 20 gigs of open storage space to enable on-device AI features.
articles.titleEn: Google reveals how much free space Chrome wants to install local AI models
summaryLinesEn: Google tells Android Authority that the models themselves will still only take up about 4 GB of storage space once installed, but the models won’t download at all unless you’ve got about 20 gigs free.
Google has updated its support documentation to show that downloading the models that power Chrome’s on-device AI features requires approximately 20 gigabytes of available storage space.

For reference, with on-device AI features disabled, my Mac lists the storage used by the Chrome browser at about 1.5 GB — less than 10% of the space required to enable on-device AI, and less than half the space on-device AI models occupy.

articles.title: The Best AI Notetakers to Record Your Meetings, Interviews, or Classes
articles.descEn: Explore our favorite pocket-size gadgets for making recordings and getting smart summaries.
articles.titleEn: The Best AI Notetakers to Record Your Meetings, Interviews, or Classes
summaryLinesEn: As with all things AI, the jury’s out on whether AI notetakers are actually useful or if bypassing the intellectual rigor of writing down what people say is going to make us even stupider, but at the very least I’ve found them to be a convenient way to capture the main points of a conversation—and helpful at keeping a record of discussions and meetings I might otherwise have promptly forgotten.
Nearly all AI notetakers push a paid subscription plan, and while most offer a stripped-down, no-cost tier, the utility of these plans varies greatly.

articles.title: Suno Plans New Tools to Make AI-Generated Music More Transparent. Is It Enough? - CNET
articles.descEn: Suno plans to flag use of its music generator using audio watermarking and fingerprint technology.
articles.titleEn: Suno Plans New Tools to Make AI-Generated Music More Transparent. Is It Enough? - CNET
summaryLinesEn: This list goes on, like Suno cracking down on any other potential attempts to copy artists by using third-party technology to screen audio files and lyrics for unauthorized use.
But platforms like Spotify are already implementing policies to crack down on deepfakes, require disclosures about AI-generated music and allow artists to file complaints.
The AI song-generation platform Suno plans to make it easier to tell if a tune you hear was made by its tools.

articles.title: Replit’s CEO on building a company that can run itself

articles.titleEn: Replit’s CEO on building a company that can run itself
summaryLinesEn: In March, Replit raised $400 million at a $9 billion valuation — triple what it was worth six months earlier.
Last month the company launched Replit Design , an agent-based creative tool.

It was actually kind of a painful moment, because here you are, you dedicated your life — I've been working on making coding easier for literally 15 years, most of my adult life — and I'm saying everything that I worked toward is kind of moot, and the way forward is that we make programming so easy that anyone could do it.

articles.title: Rivalry At Google DeepMind Preceded Recent Shakeup
articles.descEn: Even before a massive shakeup in leadership at Google’s frontier AI lab, the org had faced quiet tensions between its offices across the Atlantic.
articles.titleEn: Rivalry At Google DeepMind Preceded Recent Shakeup
summaryLinesEn: Disagreements sometimes came from how different the cultures between DeepMind, which Google bought in 2014, and Google Brain had been historically set up, former employees said.

“For me, this is the ultimate fallout of the DeepMind/Brain merger,” said one former Google DeepMind employee, who worked at the company for more than a decade, adding that Dean’s influence inside Google had “gradually been waning” since the merger, as power shifted to Hassabis and then later to Kavukcuoglu and Borgeaud.

With leadership across two continents, decision-making became sluggish, said Ben Pouladian, an analyst that covers AI infrastructure who posted on X Wednesday about the internal competition at Google between Brain, DeepMind and its other divisions.

sourceContent.headline: Rivalry At Google DeepMind Preceded Recent Shakeup
sourceContent.description: Even before a massive shakeup in leadership at Google’s frontier AI lab, the org had faced quiet tensions between its offices across the Atlantic.
paragraphs: Disagreements sometimes came from how different the cultures between DeepMind, which Google bought in 2014, and Google Brain had been historically set up, former employees said.

“For me, this is the ultimate fallout of the DeepMind/Brain merger,” said one former Google DeepMind employee, who worked at the company for more than a decade, adding that Dean’s influence inside Google had “gradually been waning” since the merger, as power shifted to Hassabis and then later to Kavukcuoglu and Borgeaud.

With leadership across two continents, decision-making became sluggish, said Ben Pouladian, an analyst that covers AI infrastructure who posted on X Wednesday about the internal competition at Google between Brain, DeepMind and its other divisions.

O n Wednesday, Google CEO Sundar Pichai made a bombshell announcement: Jeff Dean, the tech giant’s 30th employee and its chief scientist, is departing after 27 years to found his own AI startup. Meanwhile at Google DeepMind, Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis, the bigwig who founded the pioneering lab DeepMind more than 15 years ago, is stepping away from day-to-day control of the frontier lab to become its chairman and new chief scientist for Google parent Alphabet.

The changes are an abrupt reset at one of the world’s most important AI labs. But the fault lines were visible well before Wednesday, multiple former employees tell Forbes . They trace back to 2023, when Google fused DeepMind and Google Brain, its two premier AI research operations, into Google DeepMind.

The pitch was simple enough: one company, one AI army, fewer internal spats as Google scrambled to catch up to OpenAI and Anthropic. The reality was messier. Hassabis ran the combined division from London. Dean remained in Silicon Valley. Both reported directly to Pichai. There might have been a single org chart. But there were still two capitals.

localization.title: Google DeepMind의 경쟁이 최근 개편을 앞섰음
summaryLines: 전직 직원들은 구글이 2014년에 인수한 딥마인드와 역사적으로 구글 브레인의 문화가 얼마나 다르기 때문에 의견 차이가 가끔 발생했다고 말함
구글에서 10년 이상 근무한 한 전직 구글 딥마인드 직원은 "나에게 있어 이것이 딥마인드/브레인 합병의 궁극적인 결과라고 생각한다"며 "합병 이후 구글 내부에서 딘의 영향력은 점차 줄어들었다"고 덧붙였음 · 권력이 하사비스에게, 그리고 나중에는 카부크쿠오글루와 보르조에게로 옮겨갔기 때문임
X 수요일에 Brain, DeepMind 및 기타 부서 간의 Google 내부 경쟁에 대해 게시한 AI 인프라 분석가 Ben Pouladian은 두 대륙에 걸친 리더십으로 인해 의사 결정이 부진했다고 말함

articles.title: UK's job market is splitting in two as AI demand surges while knowledge work postings crater
articles.descEn: AI now appears in 9.4 percent of British job postings, up from about 2 percent in 2023, according to Indeed. Overall hiring is falling in knowledge work fields such as marketing and management, but AI-related listings are rising fast. Indeed calls it a "two-speed labor market."
articles.titleEn: UK's job market is splitting in two as AI demand surges while knowledge work postings crater
summaryLinesEn: According to Indeed's Hiring Lab, 9.4 percent of British job postings mentioned AI by the end of June 2026, up from about 2 percent in 2023, with demand spreading well beyond tech into marketing, finance, and media.
Searches for AI roles have grown sevenfold since ChatGPT launched, according to Indeed.
Ad DEC_D_Incontent-1 Jobs that require workers to be physically present unsurprisingly sit at the bottom of the list.

articles.title: SpaceX’s ambitious compute goals could require over two million Nvidia Rubin GPUs
articles.descEn: SpaceX plans to more than 5x its compute capacity by the end of 2027, betting exclusively on Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform. The expansion could require well over a million new GPUs. Meanwhile, the company's AI segment posted $2.56 billion in Q2 revenue, driven mostly by leasing out its own server capacity.
articles.titleEn: SpaceX’s ambitious compute goals could require over two million Nvidia Rubin GPUs
summaryLinesEn: SpaceX wants to grow its compute capacity more than fivefold by the end of 2027, finishing the year above two gigawatts of power, according to Elon Musk.
The transaction valued SpaceX at $1 trillion and xAI at $250 billion, for a combined $1.25 trillion.
SpaceX's AI segment, which includes xAI and X, posted $2.56 billion in revenue during Q2 2026 alongside an operating loss of $1.26 billion.

articles.title: 4 of Google’s Top AI Brains Are Leaving—and Launching Their Own AI Startup
articles.descEn: Jeff Dean and other high-profile Google executives have founded Discovery Loop, a startup that will seek AI-powered breakthroughs in everything from drug discovery to chip design.
articles.titleEn: 4 of Google’s Top AI Brains Are Leaving—and Launching Their Own AI Startup
summaryLinesEn: Today it’s official: After almost 27 years, Dean is leaving Google, along with Ghemawat and two other top-tier AI scientists, to found a company called Discovery Loop .
They put together a simple pitch deck and set out to talk to VCs about funding their company, which they set up as a public benefit corporation.

Worse, the other cofounders are also supernovas in the AI firmament: Oriol Vinyals , VP of research at DeepMind and a technical lead for Gemini, and Quoc Le , a cofounder of Google Brain and the key scientist behind Google’s AutoML-Zero, a project that uses machine learning algorithms to autonomously build AI products.

articles.title: AI Influencers Are Heading Into Uncharted Territory
articles.descEn: Some creators fear the EU AI Act’s regulatory chaos will upend their lucrative businesses. Others are owning it by incorporating AI transparency into their creative process.
articles.titleEn: AI Influencers Are Heading Into Uncharted Territory
summaryLinesEn: Estimated to be worth $14.5 billion , the virtual influencer market is projected to reach $110.4 billion by 2033, with a reported 33.6 percent annual growth rate.
Having lived through the transition from 2D to 3D animation, 60-year-old Tilkin sees the current moment as just another technological shift.

Mansbridge, 34, says she now earns around $6,000 a month through brand collaborations and designing bespoke AI influencers for brands, many of which require her to sign an NDA so she can’t disclose which ones she’s worked for.

articles.title: The AI Notetaker Has Been Invited to All the Meetings
articles.descEn: Wispr Flow, a popular dictation tool, has released a live notetaker that transcribes and summarizes meetings. It joins a growing wave of AI notetakers for the workplace.
articles.titleEn: The AI Notetaker Has Been Invited to All the Meetings
summaryLinesEn: It’s a verbatim record of our conversation generated by AI in real time, even down to my “mm-hmm” sounds while I listen to Kothari explaining why the startup, which is known for voice dictation, is dropping something new.
If you enable Privacy Mode for your account, then the data from your dictations will not be used by Wispr for AI model training .

Most tech investors and other experts I’ve chatted with this year now assume whenever they meet up with someone to talk business that the conversation is going to be recorded or transcribed by AI, sometimes without explicit consent.

articles.title: An AI agent went rogue during UK safety tests, creating fake identities and launching social engineering attacks unprompted
articles.descEn: In a security test by the British AI Safety Institute, an AI agent went rogue on the open internet without being told to. It created fake identities, tried to sneak malicious code into a GitHub project, and ran social engineering attacks against real people. Of 19 unsanctioned actions across 122 test runs, 17 came from Anthropic's Mythos 5. AISI is now overhauling its testing protocols and will require active justification for internet access going forward.
articles.titleEn: An AI agent went rogue during UK safety tests, creating fake identities and launching social engineering attacks unprompted
summaryLinesEn: Agent built fake identities and ran social engineering attacks According to AISI, an agent tried to inject malicious code into a public open source project on GitHub.

During a cybersecurity test, the British AI Safety Institute found that AI models with unrestricted internet access autonomously created fake identities and tried to sneak malicious code into an open-source project.
Without being told to do so, it created fake identities, tried to slip malicious code into an open source project, and targeted real people and organizations with social engineering attacks.

articles.title: US appeals court allows Perplexity's AI shopping agent back on Amazon
articles.descEn: A US appeals court has overturned Amazon's injunction against Perplexity's AI shopping agents, ruling that it's the users who access Amazon, not the startup. It's the first federal appeals court decision on whether AI agents can lawfully act on online platforms on behalf of users, and it could reshape the entire AI agent industry.

summaryLinesEn: A violation of federal computer fraud law is therefore unlikely to hold up.

Amazon had sued Perplexity because its AI agents log into customer accounts and place orders.

summaryLinesEn: The AI testing framework was created after President Trump signed an executive order in June , requesting that AI companies share their frontier models with the federal government prior to release to address cybersecurity concerns.

articles.title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
articles.descEn: WindBorne Systems has raised $37 million Series B round to scale its weather balloons and AI forecasts.
articles.titleEn: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
summaryLinesEn: WindBorne Systems, a startup that collects data with the world’s longest-flying weather balloons and feeds it into a powerful forecasting model , has raised a $37 million Series B round to take on that challenge, CEO John Dean told TechCrunch.

Private weather forecast companies do exist, but make most of their money repackaging or refining government forecasts for the news media, specialized needs like plane de-icing and ship routing, or the above-mentioned speculators.

The new round was co-led by Khosla Ventures and Galvanize, with additional investments from TransLink Capital, Lux Capital, and previous investors, and values the company after this round of funding at $250 million.

localization.title: AI는 날씨 예측을 더 좋게 만듬 · WindBorne이 수익성을 높일 수 있을까요
summaryLines: 세계에서 가장 오래 비행하는 기상 관측 기구로 데이터를 수집하고 이를 강력한 예측 모델에 적용하는 스타트업 WindBorne Systems가 이러한 과제를 해결하기 위해 3,700만 달러 규모의 시리즈 B 투자를 유치했다고 CEO John Dean이 TechCrunch에 말함
민간 일기 예보 회사가 존재하지만 대부분의 돈은 뉴스 미디어, 비행기 제빙 및 선박 경로 지정과 같은 전문 요구 사항 또는 위에서 언급한 투기꾼을 위해 정부 예측을 재포장하거나 정제하는 데 사용됨
새로운 라운드는 TransLink Capital, Lux Capital 및 이전 투자자의 추가 투자와 함께 Khosla Ventures 및 Galvanize가 공동 주도했으며 이번 자금 조달 라운드 이후 회사의 가치를 2억 5천만 달러로 평가함

articles.title: The Devil In The Agent
articles.descEn: As AI agents gain autonomy inside enterprises, the biggest cybersecurity threat may no longer be hackers, but the agents themselves, forcing organisations to rethink trust, permissions and runtime security.
articles.titleEn: The Devil In The Agent
summaryLinesEn: Smallest.ai Bags $13 Mn : The voice AI startup has raised ₹108 Cr in a Series A round led by Seligman Ventures to scale its enterprise voice AI platform.
Tata Communications Amps Up Voice AI Play : The telecom player and Tata Tele Business Services have launched an AI-powered voice platform for SMBs.

There are some cybersecurity industry frameworks that exist: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications developed by the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), which lists the most common AI risks MITRE ATLAS by US-based nonprofit MITRE Corporation, which maps how AI systems can be attacked AI Risk Management Framework by the US National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), which provides guidelines for deploying AI responsibly.

articles.title: Google plans to kill Assistant on your phone on September 4
articles.descEn: Assistant will disappear, leaving only Gemini for voice control in the coming weeks.
articles.titleEn: Google plans to kill Assistant on your phone on September 4
summaryLinesEn: In an email being sent out to users, Google confirms that Assistant on Android devices will be shut down starting on September 4, forcing everyone over to Gemini.
Most of Google’s smart home devices have already transitioned to Gemini.
Now that Gemini is ready to take over, Google will begin ending support for the old system on September 4, but the email notes that it may take several weeks for the process to complete.

articles.title: Google is in talks for a $1.5 billion-plus deal with AI coding agent startup Mechanize
articles.descEn: Google wants its AI to get better at coding. It might have found a shortcut with the startup Mechanize.
articles.titleEn: Google is in talks for a $1.5 billion-plus deal with AI coding agent startup Mechanize
summaryLinesEn: The deal, which some of the people said is worth over $1.5 billion, is in progress, and details could change.

Mechanize launched last year with a mission of automating every job and a star-studded group of investors, including former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman, Stripe CEO Patrick Collison, and podcaster Dwarkesh Patel.

Mechanize's tech can help tech companies improve the performance of their AI models at coding — something Google has struggled with, while OpenAI and Anthropic have scooped up developer customers with Codex and Claude Code.

articles.title: From RAN Intelligent Agents to Unified RAN Agent Inside Huawei's Push for L4+ Autonomous Mobile Networks
articles.descEn: Huawei unified its RAN Agent at MWC Barcelona 2026, connecting network and business agents via the new A2A-T protocol.
articles.titleEn: From RAN Intelligent Agents to Unified RAN Agent Inside Huawei's Push for L4+ Autonomous Mobile Networks
summaryLinesEn: This project brought together operators and vendors, including China Mobile, Orange, Huawei, ZTE , AIS, Infosys, and AsiaInfo, to establish a common set of open-source building blocks for Autonomous Network Level 4 (AN L4), supported by standardized A2A-T (Agent-to-Agent for Telecom) communication.
At MWC Barcelona 2026, Huawei introduced a unified RAN Agent.

Mobile networks are evolving from being rule-based to using intelligent agents that are capable of perceiving their surroundings, drawing conclusions and inferences independently, and taking action, removing the need for humans to intervene in the process.

summaryLines: 이 프로젝트에서는 표준화된 A2A-T(Agent-to-Agent for Telecom) 통신이 지원되는 자율 네트워크 레벨 4(AN L4)를 위한 공통 오픈 소스 빌딩 블록 세트를 구축하기 위해 China Mobile, Orange, Huawei, ZTE, AIS, Infosys, AsiaInfo를 포함한 통신업체와 공급업체가 함께 모였음
MWC 바르셀로나 2026에서 화웨이는 통합 RAN 에이전트를 선보였음
모바일 네트워크는 규칙 기반에서 주변 환경을 인식하고, 독립적으로 결론과 추론을 도출하고, 조치를 취할 수 있는 지능형 에이전트를 사용하는 방식으로 진화하고 있어 인간이 프로세스에 개입할 필요가 없음

summaryLinesEn: Agent-assisted consumer spending is forecast to reach $3–5 trillion by 2030, with business-to-business spending potentially three times higher.
Agentic commerce marks a shift from AI that supports decisions to AI that can act within conditions set in advance.

Baku, Azerbaijan — August 2026 — Mastercard’s latest Signals report “Encoding Trust: The Race for Intent, Consent and Control in the Agentic World” examines what it will take for agentic commerce to scale as AI agents move beyond searching and recommending to making decisions and transacting on behalf of consumers and businesses.

articles.title: MacPaw Partners With Liquid AI To Bring On-Device AI To Macs
articles.descEn: Liquid Foundation Models and MacPaw’s own AI stack will create the first Mac assistant with on-device intelligence, persistent memory and native task execution.
articles.titleEn: MacPaw Partners With Liquid AI To Bring On-Device AI To Macs
summaryLinesEn: The project will also develop Mnemos, MacPaw's memory layer, which lets the assistant retain context across interactions and become more useful over time.
Eney, MacPaw’s AI assistant for macOS, will be the first product to benefit from this partnership; results are expected later this year.
Ukrainian developer MacPaw and Liquid AI have partnered to co-develop a local AI stack for Mac, driven by a shared vision for private, fast, on-device intelligence.

articles.title: US court overturns Amazon injunction against Perplexity AI
articles.descEn: The dispute centres on Perplexity’s Comet browser, whose AI assistant allows users to carry out tasks, including shopping on Amazon.
articles.titleEn: US court overturns Amazon injunction against Perplexity AI
summaryLinesEn: Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.
The complaint alleges that the company unlawfully used monopsony power over its delivery service partner (DSP) network to suppress wages, worsen working conditions and limit competition.
A US appeals court has overturned an injunction that had temporarily stopped Perplexity from using its AI-powered shopping tools on Amazon's platform.

articles.title: Microsoft AI exec tells developers to default to OpenAI's top model as part of efficiency push
articles.descEn: Microsoft is taking advantage of its intellectual property rights with OpenAI, encouraging employees to use the company's top model.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft AI exec tells developers to default to OpenAI's top model as part of efficiency push
summaryLinesEn: While Microsoft has built its own artificial intelligence programming model and gives cloud customers access to over 11,000 models, including from Anthropic, the company wants staffers to take advantage of valuable intellectual property rights that come from the software giant's early investment in OpenAI.
Microsoft is telling developers working on AI coding projects to rely on OpenAI's top-tier model over rival products in a bid to maximize efficiency.
"Internally, shifting more workloads to OpenAI models helps us get greater value from our token investment," Parikh wrote.
articles.summary:
While Microsoft has built its own artificial intelligence programming model and gives cloud customers access to over 11,000 models, including from Anthropic, the company wants staffers to take advantage of valuable intellectual property rights that come from the software giant's early investment in OpenAI.

"Internally, shifting more workloads to OpenAI models helps us get greater value from our token investment," Parikh wrote.

summaryLines: Microsoft는 자체 인공 지능 프로그래밍 모델을 구축하고 클라우드 고객에게 Anthropic을 포함하여 11,000개 이상의 모델에 대한 액세스를 제공하는 한편, 회사는 직원들이 OpenAI에 대한 소프트웨어 거대 기업의 초기 투자에서 비롯된 귀중한 지적 재산권을 활용하기를 원함
마이크로소프트는 AI 코딩 프로젝트를 진행하는 개발자들에게 효율성을 극대화하기 위해 경쟁 제품보다 OpenAI의 최상위 모델을 활용하라고 지시하고 있음
Parikh는 "내부적으로 더 많은 워크로드를 OpenAI 모델로 전환하면 토큰 투자에서 더 큰 가치를 얻을 수 있음" · 라고 썼음

articles.title: AI coding agents are blowing through budgets — Replit, Kilo Code, and Symbotic explain how they're managing it
articles.descEn: Replit, Kilo Code, and Symbotic engineering leaders reveal how they track AI coding costs and stop runaway token spend before it wrecks the budget.
articles.titleEn: AI coding agents are blowing through budgets — Replit, Kilo Code, and Symbotic explain how they're managing it
summaryLinesEn: At Kilo Code, engineers are reading or writing code themselves only about 1% of the time now, according to co-founder Emilie Schario — the rest is agents.
"Let's look at it from the lens of security, elegance, clean, concise code, water tightness."

That shift is forcing new questions onto dev teams: which systems are safe to hand over, who cleans up when models goof up, how to support multi-model architectures, and whether skyrocketing token bills mean real progress or just burned IT budget.

articles.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
articles.descEn: A new SaferAI report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 approaches frontier AI capabilities while lacking key safety mitigations, renewing concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safeguards.
articles.titleEn: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
summaryLinesEn: Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip Dominic-Madori Davis Sequoia’s Shaun Maguire leads $1B round for nuclear startup Valar Atomics Julie Bort Malaysia is reportedly shutting down Balaji Srinivasan’s Network School Anthony Ha YouTuber Hank Green says his AI usage is ‘not healthy’ Anthony Ha

Advocates of open-weight AI argue that releasing the weights is important for cybersecurity because it allows companies defend themselves against attacks — Hugging Face relied on GLM-5.2 to defend itself against OpenAI’s breach — and because it allows them to better prepare for future threats if they know what’s coming.

GLM-5.2, the open-weight AI model from China’s Z.ai, is only a few months behind OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 and Anthropic’s Claude Opus 4.7 on cyber and bio capabilities, according to a new report from AI safety nonprofit SaferAI.

summaryLines: 인플루언서들은 OpenAI의 첫 럭셔리 여행에 참석해 반발을 불러일으켰음 · Dominic-Madori Davis Sequoia의 Shaun Maguire가 원자력 스타트업 Valar Atomics의 10억 달러 라운드를 주도함 · Julie Bort Malaysia는 Balaji Srinivasan의 네트워크 학교를 폐쇄한 것으로 알려졌음 · Anthony Ha 유튜버 Hank Green은 자신의 AI 사용이 '건강하지 않다'고 말함 · Anthony Ha
개방형 AI 옹호자들은 가중치를 해제하면 기업이 공격으로부터 자신을 방어할 수 있기 때문에(Hugging Face는 OpenAI의 위반으로부터 자신을 방어하기 위해 GLM-5.2를 사용함), 앞으로 무슨 일이 일어날지 안다면 미래의 위협에 더 잘 대비할 수 있기 때문에 사이버 보안에 중요하다고 주장함
AI 안전 비영리단체 SaferAI의 새로운 보고서에 따르면, 중국 Z.ai의 개방형 AI 모델인 GLM-5.2는 OpenAI의 GPT-5.5와 Anthropic의 Claude Opus 4.7에 비해 사이버 및 바이오 기능이 불과 몇 달 뒤처져 있다고 함

articles.title: AI is finding bugs faster than humans can fix them: How enterprise security teams must adapt
articles.descEn: It's far easier to find security holes than to fix them, and leaving it to AI can introduce 9 times as many new vulnerabilities as developers do.
articles.titleEn: AI is finding bugs faster than humans can fix them: How enterprise security teams must adapt
summaryLinesEn: Thus, we've ended up with an ever-growing burden on developers, security teams, and companies trying to separate exploitable issues from machine-generated noise.
AI-assisted vulnerability discovery is accelerating the pace of bug reports, but the real story is the growing mismatch between what machines can surface and what humans can realistically triage.
For instance, I used to recommend that Windows users hold off on patching their PCs because so many patches ended up going awry, such as the January 2026 Patch Tuesday update .

articles.title: Texas governor orders audit of new data centers after realizing over 400 gigawatts of power is a lot - Engadget
articles.descEn: The state already hosts more than 500 data centers.
articles.titleEn: Texas governor orders audit of new data centers after realizing over 400 gigawatts of power is a lot - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The governor's office said more than 90 percent of those requests stem from data centers, adding that "unprecedented load growth could endanger the reliability and stability of the Texas electric grid."

In response to the order, the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) must collect information about potential new data centers' ownership and finances as well as their planned power needs, water use and approach to minimizing the negative impact on residents.
According to third-party statistics, Texas is home to 521 data centers .

localization.title: 텍사스 주지사는 400기가와트 이상의 전력이 많은 것을 깨닫고 새로운 데이터 센터에 대한 감사를 명령함
summaryLines: 주지사 사무실은 이러한 요청의 90% 이상이 데이터 센터에서 비롯된 것이며 "전례 없는 부하 증가는 텍사스 전력망의 신뢰성과 안정성을 위태롭게 할 수 있다"고 덧붙였음
명령에 따라 텍사스 공공 유틸리티 위원회(PUCT)와 텍사스 전기 신뢰성 위원회(ERCOT)는 잠재적인 새로운 데이터 센터의 소유권과 재정은 물론 계획된 전력 수요, 물 사용 및 주민에 대한 부정적인 영향을 최소화하기 위한 접근 방식에 대한 정보를 수집해야 함
제3자 통계에 따르면 텍사스에는 521개의 데이터 센터가 있음

articles.title: Texas says data centers must pass an audit before connecting to the grid
articles.descEn: Texas Governor Greg Abbott (R) announced a new audit for data centers seeking to connect to the state energy grid, amid widespread backlash.
articles.titleEn: Texas says data centers must pass an audit before connecting to the grid
summaryLinesEn: But following New York’s data center moratorium , it’s a signal that elected leaders across the country are recognizing a bipartisan desire to pump the brakes on energy-intensive projects.

Data centers will need to provide information on state and local incentives they’ve received, how much they’d rely on the state grid, expected water consumption and sources, and how they plan to track community impacts including noise.

Governor Greg Abbott (R) on Monday directed the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) to verify and audit new data center proposals, writing that the review is needed to “keep the grid stable and reliable.”

summaryLines: 그러나 뉴욕의 데이터 센터 운영 중단 이후, 이는 전국의 선출된 지도자들이 에너지 집약적인 프로젝트에 제동을 걸고자 하는 초당적인 열망을 인식하고 있다는 신호임
데이터 센터는 받은 주 및 지역 인센티브, 주 전력망에 얼마나 의존할지, 예상 물 소비량 및 공급원, 소음을 포함한 지역사회 영향을 추적할 계획에 대한 정보를 제공해야 함
Greg Abbott 주지사(공화당)는 월요일 텍사스 공공 유틸리티 위원회(PUCT)와 텍사스 전기 신뢰성 위원회(ERCOT)에 새로운 데이터 센터 제안을 검증하고 감사하도록 지시했으며 "그리드를 안정적이고 신뢰할 수 있게 유지"하기 위해 검토가 필요하다고 썼음

articles.descEn: That's a lot of capital expenditure.
articles.titleEn: SpaceX's first public earnings statement shows the financials of an AI company in 2026 - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: As a whole, SpaceX increased revenue by 92 percent year-over-year, bringing its total revenue for the quarter to $7.8 billion.
Further complicating those numbers is that Anthropic has agreed to pay $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 to use SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center for its compute needs.
The company also shaved the gap between its revenue and operating expenses by more than half, reducing net losses to $541 million, down from $1 billion a year ago.

articles.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
articles.descEn: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply. But even Texas can be pushed to the brink.
articles.titleEn: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
summaryLinesEn: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply.

Governor Greg Abbott announced Monday that all new data center projects will need to be audited by both the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) and the state’s grid operator, the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT).

While many data center operators, including Google and Microsoft , have been drawn to Texas for its ample natural gas reserves, wind and solar have helped ERCOT keep pace with growing electricity demand, according to the Energy Information Administration (EIA).

articles.title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
articles.descEn: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. The paid tool will let fans create AI-generated covers and remixes of participating artists’ music while ensuring artists opt in, receive credit, and are compensated.
articles.titleEn: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
summaryLinesEn: Music streamer Deezer recently noted that more than 50% of daily track uploads were generated with AI , up from 10% in January 2025.
“Our remix and covers I think is an incredibly exciting product again because there is no one else that can really do this,” Söderström said.
The new tool will launch as a paid add-on, creating an additional revenue stream for artists, Spotify previously said.

articles.title: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot - Engadget
articles.descEn: Amazon's public fight with Perplexity over online shopping started in November 2025.
articles.titleEn: Perplexity has successfully overturned Amazon's injunction on its AI shopping bot - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: According to an opinion from the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, Amazon's original claim that Perplexity violated the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA) doesn't hold up to scrutiny and shouldn't have been rewarded with an injunction.

Successfully claiming that Perplexity violated the law requires Amazon to prove that the company intentionally accessed a computer without authorization, obtained information from that protected computer and that there was a loss "to one or more persons during any one-year period" that averaged at least $5,000 in value.

According to Amazon, both companies had agreed to an earlier pause on agentic shopping in 2024, but Perplexity went back on the agreement and re-enabled the feature by disguising Comet's AI bot as a normal Chrome browser.

Successfully claiming that Perplexity violated the law requires Amazon to prove that the company intentionally accessed a computer without authorization, obtained information from that protected computer and that there was a loss "to one or more persons during any one-year period" that averaged at least $5,000 in value.

According to Amazon, both companies had agreed to an earlier pause on agentic shopping in 2024, but Perplexity went back on the agreement and re-enabled the feature by disguising Comet's AI bot as a normal Chrome browser.

localization.title: Perplexity는 AI 쇼핑 봇에 대한 Amazon의 금지 명령을 성공적으로 번복함
summaryLines: 제9순회항소법원의 의견에 따르면, Perplexity가 컴퓨터 사기 및 남용법(CFAA)을 위반했다는 Amazon의 원래 주장은 조사를 통과하지 못했으며 금지 명령으로 보상받아서는 안 됨
Perplexity가 법을 위반했다고 성공적으로 주장하려면 Amazon은 회사가 허가 없이 의도적으로 컴퓨터에 액세스하고 보호된 컴퓨터에서 정보를 얻었으며 "1년 동안 한 명 이상의 사람에게" 평균 가치가 5,000달러 이상인 손실이 있었다는 사실을 증명해야 함
Amazon에 따르면 두 회사는 2024년에 에이전트 쇼핑을 조기에 중단하는 데 동의했지만 Perplexity는 합의를 취소하고 Comet의 AI 봇을 일반 Chrome 브라우저로 위장하여 기능을 다시 활성화함

articles.title: The White House Is Keeping Its AI Cybersecurity Framework Secret
articles.descEn: The Trump administration shared the details of its plan with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs on Tuesday. For now, the public remains in the dark.
articles.titleEn: The White House Is Keeping Its AI Cybersecurity Framework Secret
summaryLinesEn: The Trump administration invited staffers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Nvidia, and other leading AI companies to the White House on Tuesday to share an overview of its new AI oversight framework, the people said.
On Tuesday, Nvidia and the same coalition of companies launched a new project called SAFE, or Shared AI Findings Exchange.

A second White House official, who requested anonymity because they were not authorized to speak to the media, emphasized that the new framework is intentionally narrow and is focused exclusively on the cybersecurity capabilities of the most advanced models on the market, such as Anthropic’s Fable and OpenAI’s ChatGPT 5.6.

articles.title: OK, Well, Rogue AI Agents Are Hacking Again
articles.descEn: Rogue AI agents from OpenAI and Anthropic have again been caught trying to disrupt servers and software—and leaving instructions for future bad behavior.
articles.titleEn: OK, Well, Rogue AI Agents Are Hacking Again
summaryLinesEn: In a recent bout of testing , models from both Anthropic and OpenAI took “autonomous, unsanctioned action on the live internet” a total of 19 times over 122 training runs.
It went so far as to create online personas “to pressure the project's maintainer to approve the code,” according to AISI.
In what the institute described as “the most serious case,” an AI agent attempted to insert malicious code into an open-source project on GitHub.

articles.title: Silicon Valley’s rift over open source pushes back contemplated White House bans on Chinese AI
articles.descEn: The Trump administration discussed sanctions and cloud bans targeting Chinese open-source AI models, according to the New York Times. OpenAI and Anthropic pushed for restrictions, while Nvidia, Google, and Meta fought back. After pushback from Silicon Valley, Washington backed off for now, but a decision is expected before Xi Jinping's visit in September.
articles.titleEn: Silicon Valley’s rift over open source pushes back contemplated White House bans on Chinese AI
summaryLinesEn: At Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, and Meta, executives grew worried that the two AI companies, both planning IPOs, could convince the White House and lock in their market position.
Nvidia also launched an alliance for open security tools that grew from a handful of members to more than 230.
The Trump administration considered sanctions and trade bans targeting Chinese open-source AI models, according to the New York Times.

articles.title: This year's Pulitzer Prizes saw a record number of winners disclose AI use
articles.descEn: A record eight entries honored at the 2026 Pulitzer Prizes disclosed using AI, including five winners. Newsrooms such as the Wall Street Journal and AP used LLMs mainly to search large document sets faster. Pulitzer administrator Marjorie Miller said AI remains off-limits for writing and editing stories.
articles.titleEn: This year's Pulitzer Prizes saw a record number of winners disclose AI use
summaryLinesEn: A record eight Pulitzer awardees disclosed using AI this year, including five winners and three finalists, Nieman Lab reports .
This year, entrants used AI tools and large language models more often, mainly to search large document sets faster.

Pulitzer administrator Marjorie Miller told Nieman Lab that the news industry now accepts "AI is here to stay" and better understands where its use is appropriate and "when it might not, such as in writing and editing stories in any format that might be considered for a Pulitzer Prize."

articles.title: The 2026 R&D Benchmark Report: Waste, AI and the Race to Market - Wiley Science and Engineering Content Hub
articles.descEn: Download the Complimentary Industry Report! Innovation leaders face increasing pressure to deliver breakthrough products faster while making smarter investment decisions. Yet, new research shows that many organizations continue to lose significant R&D budget on projects that never reach commercialization, even as AI adoption accelerates. Based on a survey of more than 200 senior R&D professionals across North America, the UK, and Europe, this industry report reveals where innovation teams are losing time, budget, and competitive advantage—and how better intelligence can improve decision-making before costly investments are made. In this report, you'll learn: Why more than one-third of organizations spend 25–40% of their R&D budget on projects that never reach market. Why nearly half of respondents estimate losing more than $1 million every time a late-stage project is canceled. How AI adoption has surged, yet most organizations still use it primarily for execution, not for the strategic decisions that determine which projects deserve investment. Why earlier access to competitive, market, and patent intelligence delivers the greatest impact during ideation and feasibility, before significant resources are committed. Click 'LOOK INSIDE' to reserve your complimentary copy

articles.title: AMD’s data center business is booming while gaming takes a backseat
articles.descEn: AMD reports its data center revenue jumped 107 percent in Q2 2026 compared to last year, while its gaming business dropped 31 percent.
articles.titleEn: AMD’s data center business is booming while gaming takes a backseat
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All Tech The company’s data center revenue has more than doubled, hitting $6.7 billion.

“Revenue increased 50 percent year-over-year to a record $11.5 billion, driven by continued strength in our Data Center business, which represented 58% of company revenue in the quarter,” wrote AMD CFO Jean Hu.
Driven by demand for AI capacity, AMD’s data center revenue more than doubled year-over-year in its latest earnings report , reaching $6.7 billion.

articles.title: This AI Agent Can Negotiate Bills for You – if It Doesn't Reject the Lower Offers - CNET
articles.descEn: Can an AI agent snap you a better phone or internet deal? Only if you give it multiple express permissions, and can get it to input the one-time passcode fast enough.
articles.titleEn: This AI Agent Can Negotiate Bills for You – if It Doesn't Reject the Lower Offers - CNET
summaryLinesEn: The rep offered to switch to a newer plan at $50 per line with the same features, but the agent declined as it involved a plan change.
They offered a $10 discount plus an additional $10 off with autopay, but because the agent doesn’t accept autopay changes, the negotiation would have resulted in a $10 monthly saving.
Kudos support said the savings would have been $20 a month or $240 a year if the one-time passcode worked, and if I’d given the agent custom instructions to accept autopay.

articles.title: Mistral Is in the Right Place at the Right Time
articles.descEn: Open-weight AI models are having a moment in the wake of recent turmoil at US tech giants. For French AI lab Mistral, that’s the the best thing that could have happened.
articles.titleEn: Mistral Is in the Right Place at the Right Time
summaryLinesEn: Last September, Mistral raised almost $2 billion at a $13.5 billion valuation; it's reportedly teeing up another raise that will bump that figure to $23 billion.
Unlike the leading American labs, locked in a race to superintelligence , Mistral has shifted its focus toward smaller, bespoke models for manufacturing, utilities, and financial services.

“Everybody outside the US and China should participate in the open source ecosystem, because it takes leverage away,” says Nicolas Granatino, founder of startup accelerator StemAI, who holds a stake in Mistral in a personal capacity.

summaryLines: 지난 9월 미스트랄은 평가액 135억 달러로 거의 20억 달러를 모금함 · 보도에 따르면 그 수치를 230억 달러로 끌어올릴 또 다른 인상이 예정되어 있음
초지능을 향한 경쟁에 갇힌 선도적인 미국 연구소와 달리 Mistral은 제조, 유틸리티 및 금융 서비스를 위한 소규모 맞춤형 모델에 초점을 전환함
개인 자격으로 Mistral의 지분을 보유하고 있는 스타트업 액셀러레이터 StemAI의 설립자 Nicolas Granatino는 "미국과 중국 이외의 모든 사람은 오픈 소스 생태계에 참여해야 함 · 왜냐하면 레버리지를 빼앗기 때문임" · 라고 말함

articles.title: SpaceX's AI spending unnerves Wall Street despite promises of quick payoff
articles.descEn: In addressing Wall Street for the first time since SpaceX's IPO, executives tried to make the case that hefty AI investments are paying off within a year.
articles.titleEn: SpaceX's AI spending unnerves Wall Street despite promises of quick payoff
summaryLinesEn: CFO Bret Johnsen said that in the first few weeks of the current quarter, SpaceX contracted an additional $6.7 billion of cloud services revenue "that begins ramping starting in October."
Bret Johnsen, SpaceX's CFO, suggested on the earnings call that investors should start thinking differently about capex because of how quickly it's converting into revenue.
Prior to that, Anthropic announced a deal that would involve paying up to $1.25 billion a month for three years for compute capacity at SpaceX's Colossus data center in Memphis, Tennessee.

articles.title: How to use location sharing to build trust on vacation
articles.descEn: Learn how location sharing can help families build trust, encourage independence and improve safety without making kids feel monitored while traveling for vacation.
articles.titleEn: How to use location sharing to build trust on vacation
summaryLinesEn: A recent “Parenting in a Digital World” survey found that nearly 4 in 10 parents rely more on location sharing while traveling, while another 25% say they check in more often through family group chats.

If location sharing is introduced as a shared safety tool that makes more independence possible—not as a way to monitor every movement—it can change the conversation and pre-empt any defensive responses.
Location sharing is most helpful when family members split up for age-appropriate activities, need to reconnect at a meeting place or want peace of mind while exploring separately.

위치 공유는 가족 구성원이 연령에 맞는 활동을 위해 헤어졌거나, 모임 장소에서 다시 연결해야 하거나, 따로 탐색하면서 마음의 평화를 원할 때 가장 유용함

articles.title: Your users are already on Arm – is your software targeting it?
articles.descEn: Learn how Arm architecture shapes cloud, gaming, and on-device AI workloads—and how to test, optimize, and scale your software for Arm.
articles.titleEn: Your users are already on Arm – is your software targeting it?
summaryLinesEn: With 99% of smartphones running on Arm, around 50% of Arm-based compute shipped to leading hyperscalers, and more than 350 billion Arm-based chips shipped to date, the Arm architecture already powers many of the platforms developers build for every day.
Once running, benchmarking tools such as Arm Performix can help provide insights into hotspots, memory usage, and CPU efficiency to guide optimization.
So, whether you are building for cloud, games, or apps with on-device AI, your software may already run on the Arm compute platform without being deliberately optimized for it.

articles.title: Arm Neural Technology gaining momentum across the mobile gaming ecosystem
articles.descEn: Discover how Arm Neural Technology, game engines, studios, and developer tools are making neural graphics production-ready for mobile gaming.
articles.titleEn: Arm Neural Technology gaining momentum across the mobile gaming ecosystem
summaryLinesEn: Mobile gamers expect richer lighting, smoother gameplay, and increasingly immersive visual experiences without compromising battery life, thermal performance, or responsiveness.
These collaborations make neural graphics capabilities available through the engines and workflows developers already use, reducing integration effort, and accelerating adoption across the industry.

One example is Neural Dawn, the game project co-developed with Sumo Digital that showcases how Arm Neural Technology can enable desktop-quality graphics techniques, including advanced lighting, ray-traced effects and AI-powered rendering, within a mobile power envelope.

articles.descEn: Click the article to explore the latest cutting-edge updates, breakthrough trends, and industry-shifting developments in the global AI track. This in-depth coverage delivers real-time insights into emerging artificial intelligence technologies, innovative application scenarios, market dynamics, and forward-looking industry shifts, keeping tech practitioners, AI enthusiasts, industry researchers, and business decision-makers fully informed of the most valuable latest evolutions across the fast-growing artificial intelligence landscape.
articles.titleEn: How Small & Medium AI Developers Stand Out in Vertical Niche Scenarios Amid Fierce General AI Competition – Insights From ChatGPT & Claude’s Global Bestseller List Success
summaryLinesEn: From the changes in the AI application market trends in 2026 and the monitoring of data of small and medium-sized apps on the App Store, it can be observed that the market size of AI products is not equal to their growth rate, and top products do not have all-round monopoly.

When general-purpose AI assistants occupy the top positions on the ranking list, the breakthrough direction for new entrants is shifting from replicating the general chat entry to focusing on more segmented, specific vertical scenarios with more intuitive value.

According to the monitoring data from Qimai Data, at 10:00 on August 3, ChatGPT ranked 1st and Claude ranked 10th in the overall paid bestseller list for iPhone in the United States; meanwhile, among the top 5 apps on the US iPhone efficiency paid bestseller list, four AI products namely ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Perplexity took up 4 spots.

articles.title: Qualcomm Insights: When Will the Smartphone Industry Recover from Doldrums as the AI Craze Cools?
articles.descEn: Severe storage constraints are currently acting as a critical bottleneck hindering the healthy development of the global smartphone sector, while the overhyped, pie-in-the-sky performance and capacity promises that have long been marketed for the data center industry remain largely unfulfilled, creating widespread operational and scalability challenges for enterprise IT infrastructure deployments, cloud service providers, and edge computing ecosystems worldwide. This dual storage crisis is impeding innovation across consumer mobile hardware, enterprise data management, AI big data processing, and high-density server optimization, making targeted breakthroughs in next-generation storage technologies a top priority for the entire global tech supply chain.
articles.titleEn: Qualcomm Insights: When Will the Smartphone Industry Recover from Doldrums as the AI Craze Cools?
summaryLinesEn: Core Metrics : Qualcomm posted $9.95 billion in revenue this quarter, down 4% year over year, beating market expectations of $9.6 billion.

Judging from the next quarter guidance, the company expects revenue of $9.7 billion to $10.5 billion for the next quarter, showing no obvious signs of recovery; Non-GAAP EPS is expected to be $2.05 to $2.25, below market expectations of $2.36.
The company's gross margin for the quarter was 53.1%, down 2.5 percentage points year over year and below market expectations of 54.6% .

articles.title: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
articles.descEn: June emerged from stealth today with a $20 million pre-seed round to make AI adoption simpler.
articles.titleEn: A Marc Benioff-backed startup thinks AI can solve the AI deployment problem
summaryLinesEn: To pursue it, the company raised $20 million in pre-seed funding led by Marc Benioff’s Time Ventures, with additional backing from tech luminaries like Michael Dell, Aaron Levie and George Kurtz.
The four founders previously started Bonobo AI , a pre-transformer language model company that launched a voice-to-text service in 2017.

It’s so hard for big businesses to get AI tools working reliably that whole new organizations of forward-deployed engineers or FDEs— specialists who drop into a company to get its AI systems up and running — are springing up to help them.

articles.title: Unicorn, pelican, Middle-earth: OpenAI co-founder Karpathy is looking for the next AI vibe test
articles.descEn: One paragraph of "Lord of the Rings" in, 5,500 lines of code out. Andrej Karpathy had Claude Opus 5 turn Tolkien's opening into a 3D browser scene.
articles.titleEn: Unicorn, pelican, Middle-earth: OpenAI co-founder Karpathy is looking for the next AI vibe test
summaryLinesEn: For Karpathy, who works at Anthropic, the test shows the potential for cheap, custom game worlds built on demand.
The model placed and animated objects on its own but made mistakes because it could only check its own video output through screenshots.
The model worked for about two hours, had a budget of one million tokens (roughly $10), and rendered everything in Three.js, a graphics library for 3D in the browser.

articles.title: Two teams solved the same quantum crypto problem using GPT-5.6 just three hours apart
articles.descEn: Two research teams independently solved the same open quantum cryptography problem using OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra, submitting their papers just three hours apart. "If someone mentions an open problem, the first thing is to see if GPT solves it," says one of the researchers. The case raises a question: what does "independent discovery" mean when everyone uses the same models?
articles.titleEn: Two teams solved the same quantum crypto problem using GPT-5.6 just three hours apart
summaryLinesEn: Math in particular is feeling AI's impact, and reactions range from excitement about new possibilities to depression over a lost sense of identity .
Both used the same AI model but took different approaches to "unclonable encryption," a method that relies on quantum properties.
But the case raises a bigger question: when every researcher has access to the same models, what still counts as an independent discovery?

articles.title: EU announces new rules on AI transparency - Engadget
articles.descEn: The European Union has announced that new AI rules are now enforceable across the bloc.
articles.titleEn: EU announces new rules on AI transparency - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The new law has some teeth, with fines up to €15 million or three percent of global annual revenue for companies and €750k for EU institutions, bodies and agencies.
The new rules require an "AI" mark if machines assisted in the creation of "authentic-looking" deepfake content (image, audio, video) or published text.
The European Union has announced that it's new AI transparency rules are now in effect and enforceable across the bloc as of August 2nd.

summaryLinesEn: For its second quarter, the company reported $1.9 billion in revenue, up 93% over the year-ago quarter, and $1.1 billion in profit, “more profit in a single quarter than we did in total revenue in the same period the year before,” he wrote.

This theory points to the significant list of companies that partnered or paid for Anthropic and OpenAI while the AI labs launched similar businesses ranging from design tools to healthcare operations, legal, even drug discovery.

He asked on the call if companies are going “to buy into a future” where your job helps your “adversaries win, and everybody who does win is a small, tiny group of people living in a tiny place that somehow believe because they eat vegetables and they don’t support war fighters that they deserve to have the total means of production of this country?

articles.title: AI Conquered Coding. Fast Food Is Next
articles.descEn: Your next drive-thru order might be taken by a bot. And you might not even notice.
articles.titleEn: AI Conquered Coding. Fast Food Is Next
summaryLinesEn: In 2024, roughly 4 percent of fast-food locations in the US used voice AI technology in the drive-thru lane, according to Intouch Insight’s annual Drive Thru Survey.

Imagine pulling up to McDonald’s and having a chipper automated voice offer you a buy-one-get-one-free milkshake deal—then realizing that the chain offered you the deal because it calculated you are 78 percent more likely to order dessert on the second Tuesday of every month.
Last year, that figure grew to 5 percent; early research suggests that has now climbed to 6 percent.

sourceContent.description: Your next drive-thru order might be taken by a bot. And you might not even notice.
paragraphs: In 2024, roughly 4 percent of fast-food locations in the US used voice AI technology in the drive-thru lane, according to Intouch Insight’s annual Drive Thru Survey.

Imagine pulling up to McDonald’s and having a chipper automated voice offer you a buy-one-get-one-free milkshake deal—then realizing that the chain offered you the deal because it calculated you are 78 percent more likely to order dessert on the second Tuesday of every month.
Last year, that figure grew to 5 percent; early research suggests that has now climbed to 6 percent.

articles.title: AI shopping searches surged 200% in one year - and it's a top priority for commerce leaders now
articles.descEn: Eighty-six percent of commerce leaders believe AI is raising the bar for customer expectations.
articles.titleEn: AI shopping searches surged 200% in one year - and it's a top priority for commerce leaders now
summaryLinesEn: The use of agentic AI search as the first step in shopping online grew by 200% in the last 12 months, according to Salesforce 's State of Commerce report , a survey of 3,450 commerce professionals and 4,690 consumers, plus behavioral data from more than 1.5 billion global shoppers.

Also: Why more consumers prefer AI-enhanced shopping - and still expect the human touch The commerce businesses that will win and outpace the market are the ones that focus on data, scaling AI in production, reskilling their employees, and system integrations that unify customer data across all systems to ensure sales, service, marketing, and commerce teams have a unified view of their business and their customers' needs and expectations.

Also: Google says AI agents spending your money is a 'more fun' way to shop The top challenge for commerce leaders is the implementation and expansion of AI capabilities -- a top opportunity and challenge.

summaryLines: 3,450명의 상거래 전문가와 4,690명의 소비자를 대상으로 실시한 Salesforce의 상업 현황 보고서와 15억 명 이상의 전 세계 쇼핑객의 행동 데이터에 따르면 온라인 쇼핑의 첫 번째 단계로 에이전트 AI 검색의 사용은 지난 12개월 동안 200% 증가함

또한 · 더 많은 소비자가 AI로 강화된 쇼핑을 선호하고 여전히 인간의 손길을 기대하는 이유 시장에서 승리하고 앞서 나갈 상거래 비즈니스는 데이터, 생산에서 AI 확장, 직원 재교육, 모든 시스템에서 고객 데이터를 통합하여 영업, 서비스, 마케팅 및 상거래 팀이 비즈니스와 고객의 요구 및 기대에 대한 통합된 보기를 갖도록 보장하는 시스템 통합에 중점을 두는 비즈니스임
또한 · Google은 AI 에이전트가 돈을 쓰는 것이 '더 재미있는' 쇼핑 방법이라고 말함 · 상거래 리더의 가장 큰 과제는 AI 기능의 구현 및 확장임 · 이는 최고의 기회이자 과제임

articles.title: AI is both a cyber weapon and a massive target, CrowdStrike warns
articles.descEn: The same AI tools triggering suspicious alerts are being attacked by cybercriminals in droves.
articles.titleEn: AI is both a cyber weapon and a massive target, CrowdStrike warns
summaryLinesEn: Also: Assume AI cybersecurity attacks are the future: 43% of companies have already experienced it There are now 2.5 times as many AI agent-triggered leads for the firm's threat hunters to examine as there are manually driven leads, which CrowdStrike said "makes it more difficult for defenders to distinguish malicious activity from expected AI-driven behavior."
From January through June 2026, 88% of exploits detected by CrowdStrike were launched within 48 hours of a public proof-of-concept (PoC) code release.
For example, CrowdStrike said that in one campaign, the victim's LLM was used to generate close to 200,000 API requests in two minutes, "resulting in large-scale financial and operational impact."

articles.title: Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa
articles.descEn: AI is involved in 55 percent of reported cybercrimes in Africa, according to a new Interpol report. Financial losses more than doubled from $192 million to $484 million, and about 600,000 cases of digital extortion involving deepfakes were recorded.
articles.titleEn: Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa
summaryLinesEn: AI is involved in 55 percent of reported cybercrimes in Africa, according to a new Interpol report.
The year 2025 marks the point where AI shifted from a useful tool to what the agency calls the "core operational driver of cybercrime in Africa" on the continent.
Four Interpol-coordinated operations in 2025 and 2026 led to more than 1,500 arrests and the seizure of over $100 million.
